            <div class="section-head"><h2>Dateibaum</h2><span class="count" id="fileFilterCount"></span></div>
            <div class="file-tools" data-testid="file-tree-filters">
                <input class="field-input" id="fileSearch" data-testid="file-search-input" placeholder="Pfad oder Datei suchen…" autocomplete="off">
                <select class="field-select" id="languageFilter" data-testid="language-filter"><option value="all">Alle Sprachen</option></select>
                <select class="field-select" id="severityFilter" data-testid="severity-filter"><option value="all">Alle Status</option><option value="critical">Mit Befunden</option><option value="warning">Warnung</option><option value="clean">Sauber</option></select>
                <span class="filter-count" id="visibleFileCount">0 Dateien</span>
            </div>
            <div class="filter-favorites" data-testid="filter-favorites">
                <select class="field-select" id="filterPresetSelect" data-testid="filter-preset-select"><option value="">Gespeicherten Filter wählen…</option></select>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="saveFilterBtn" type="button" data-testid="save-filter-button">Filter speichern</button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="deleteFilterBtn" type="button" data-testid="delete-filter-button">Favorit löschen</button>
            </div>
            <table class="per-file" data-testid="per-file-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Datei</th><th>Sprache</th><th>Zeilen</th><th>Kritisch</th><th>W(t)</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody id="perFileBody"></tbody>
            </table>

            <div class="cert" id="certCard" data-testid="certificate-card">
                <div class="cert-brand">
                    <span class="cert-logo-chip"><img src="auditiq-logo.png" alt="AuditIQ Logo"></span>
                    <div>
                        <div class="cert-brand-name">AuditIQ</div>
                        <div class="cert-brand-sub">DETERMINISTIC CODE AUDIT · ZERTIFIKAT</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="cert-hero">
                    <div class="cert-seal" id="certSeal" data-testid="certificate-seal"></div>
                    <div><div class="cert-project-label">Geprüftes Projekt</div><div class="cert-project" id="certProject" data-testid="certificate-project"></div><div class="cert-project-meta" id="certProjectMeta" data-testid="certificate-project-meta"></div></div>
                    <div class="cert-score"><strong id="certScore" data-testid="certificate-score">0</strong><span>AUDIT SCORE / 100</span></div>
                </div>
                <div class="cert-top" id="certTop" data-testid="certificate-status"></div>
                <div class="cert-grid" id="certGrid"></div>
                <div class="cert-share-panel" data-testid="certificate-qr-panel">
                    <div class="cert-qr" id="certQr" data-testid="certificate-qr-code"></div>
                    <div><div class="cert-share-title">Datenschutzfreundlich verifizieren</div><p class="cert-share-copy">QR-Code und Link enthalten nur Ergebnisdaten und Signaturen. Quellcode und Dateinamen bleiben auf diesem Gerät.</p><input class="cert-link" id="certShareLink" data-testid="certificate-share-link" readonly></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="actions">
                <button class="btn" id="newAuditBtn" type="button" data-testid="new-audit-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 1 3 6.7"/><path d="M3 20v-5h5"/></svg>
                    Neues Audit
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="exportBtn" type="button" data-testid="export-report-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 3v5h5"/></svg>
                    Bericht als PDF
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="certBtn" type="button" data-testid="download-cert-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3l7 3v6c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 8.5C8 19.5 5 16.5 5 12V6z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg>
                    Zertifikat als PDF
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="shareCertBtn" type="button" data-testid="share-certificate-button">Zertifikatslink kopieren</button>
            </div>
            <div class="share-note">Der Link enthält ausschließlich Status, Score, Dateianzahl, Zeilenzahl und Signatur — niemals Quellcode oder Dateinamen.</div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <section id="view-shared" class="view" data-testid="shared-certificate-view">
        <div class="shared-wrap">
            <div class="eyebrow">GETEILTE PRÜFBESTÄTIGUNG</div>
            <h1>AuditIQ Zertifikat</h1>
            <p class="lead" style="margin:0 0 28px">Diese Ansicht enthält keine Quelltexte oder Dateinamen.</p>
            <div class="cert" id="sharedCertCard" data-testid="shared-certificate-card">
                <div class="cert-brand"><span class="cert-logo-chip"><img src="auditiq-logo.png" alt="AuditIQ Logo"></span><div><div class="cert-brand-name">AuditIQ</div><div class="cert-brand-sub">PRIVACY-SAFE VERIFICATION</div></div></div>
                <div class="cert-hero"><div class="cert-seal" id="sharedCertSeal"></div><div><div class="cert-project-label">Anonymisiertes Projekt</div><div class="cert-project">Geteiltes Code-Audit</div><div class="cert-project-meta" id="sharedCertMeta"></div></div><div class="cert-score"><strong id="sharedCertScore"></strong><span>AUDIT SCORE / 100</span></div></div>
                <div class="cert-top" id="sharedCertStatus"></div><div class="cert-grid" id="sharedCertGrid"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="actions"><button class="btn" id="sharedHomeBtn" type="button" data-testid="shared-home-button">AuditIQ öffnen</button></div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer" data-testid="site-footer">
        <div class="cprt">© 2026 <strong>Patrick Frank Buckreus</strong> (geb. 05.01.1996) · AuditIQ · Alle Rechte vorbehalten.</div>
        <div class="meta">Deterministische, zero-egress Code-Analyse — jede Prüfung erzeugt eine zeitgestempelte Signatur.</div>
    </footer>

    <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script src="/vendor/qrcode.js"></script>
<script>
    // =========================================================================
    // AuditIQ — AUDIT ENGINE (deterministic, zero-egress)  [field-theory core]
    // =========================================================================
    const PHI = 1.61803398875;
    const OMEGA_CRITICAL = 5800.0;
    const ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 1.0;
    const WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.8;

    function getLanguage(filename) {
        if (filename.endsWith('.js') || filename.endsWith('.mjs') || filename.endsWith('.cjs')) return 'javascript';
        if (filename.endsWith('.ts') || filename.endsWith('.tsx')) return 'typescript';
        if (filename.endsWith('.jsx')) return 'jsx';
        if (filename.endsWith('.html') || filename.endsWith('.htm')) return 'html';
        if (filename.endsWith('.css') || filename.endsWith('.scss') || filename.endsWith('.sass')) return 'css';
        if (filename.endsWith('.json')) return 'json';
        if (filename.endsWith('.yaml') || filename.endsWith('.yml')) return 'yaml';
        if (filename.endsWith('.toml')) return 'toml';
        return 'unknown';
    }

    function analyzeFile(file) {
        const content = file.content;
        const lines = content.split('\n');

        const security = {
            evalCount: (content.match(/\beval\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            innerHTMLCount: (content.match(/\.innerHTML/g) || []).length,
            documentWriteCount: (content.match(/document\.write/g) || []).length,
            sqlConcatCount: (content.match(/SELECT\s+.*\+\s*/gi) || []).length,
            hardcodedSecretCount: (content.match(/password\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"]+['"]/gi) || []).length,
            unsafeDeserializationCount: (content.match(/JSON\.parse\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            xssRiskCount: (content.match(/\.innerHTML|dangerouslySetInnerHTML/g) || []).length,
            insecureRandomCount: (content.match(/Math\.random\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            protoPollutionCount: (content.match(/__proto__|prototype\s*\[/g) || []).length,
            pathTraversalCount: (content.match(/\.\.\/|\.\.\\/g) || []).length,
            postMessageCount: (content.match(/postMessage\s*\([^,]*\)/g) || []).length,
            locationHashCount: (content.match(/location\.hash/g) || []).length,
            dateNowCount: (content.match(/Date\.now\s*\(\s*\)/g) || []).length,
            totalCritical: 0
        };
        const lineHits = {};
        for (const pattern of PATTERNS) {
            lineHits[pattern.key] = lines.reduce((hits, line, index) => {
                if (pattern.regex.test(line)) hits.push(index + 1);
                return hits;
            }, []);
        }

        security.totalCritical = security.evalCount + security.innerHTMLCount +
                               security.documentWriteCount + security.sqlConcatCount +
                               security.hardcodedSecretCount + security.unsafeDeserializationCount +
                               security.xssRiskCount + security.protoPollutionCount +
                               security.pathTraversalCount + security.postMessageCount;

        const performance = {
            cyclomaticComplexity: (content.match(/\bif\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bwhile\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bfor\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bswitch\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            nestingDepth: Math.max(...content.split('\n').map(line => {
                let depth = 0;
                for (const c of line) {
                    if (c === '{') depth++;
                    if (c === '}') depth--;
                }
                return depth;
            }), 0),
            totalLines: lines.length,
            totalFunctions: (content.match(/function\s+\w*\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                             (content.match(/=>\s*{/g) || []).length,
            nestedLoops: Math.max(0, (content.match(/for\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                   (content.match(/while\s*\(/g) || []).length - 1),
            blockingIOCount: (content.match(/fs\.readFileSync|fs\.writeFileSync|XMLHttpRequest/g) || []).length
        };

        const cognitive = {
            past: Math.min(performance.cyclomaticComplexity * 0.3, 10.0),
            present: Math.min(performance.nestingDepth * 0.5 + performance.totalFunctions * 0.2, 10.0),
            future: Math.min(security.totalCritical * 0.5, 10.0)
        };

        const loadY = 0.2 * cognitive.past + 0.5 * cognitive.present + 0.3 * cognitive.future;
        const frictionW = Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * PHI;
        const omegaT = frictionW * 14.0;

        return {
            filename: file.filename,
            language: file.language,
            totalLines: lines.length,
            cognitive,
            security,
            lineHits,
            performance,
            loadY,
            frictionW,
            omegaT,
            isZeroDefect: loadY <= ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && security.totalCritical === 0,
            isCritical: omegaT >= OMEGA_CRITICAL,
            isWarning: loadY > WARNING_THRESHOLD
        };
    }

    function analyzeFiles(files) {
        const findings = [];
        const fileMetrics = [];

        for (const file of files) {
            const metrics = analyzeFile(file);
            fileMetrics.push(metrics);
        }

        const aggregateCognitive = {
            past: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.past, 0) / fileMetrics.length,
            present: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.present, 0) / fileMetrics.length,
            future: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.future, 0) / fileMetrics.length
        };

        const loadY = 0.2 * aggregateCognitive.past + 0.5 * aggregateCognitive.present + 0.3 * aggregateCognitive.future;
        const frictionW = Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * PHI;
        const omegaT = frictionW * 14.0;

        const totalCritical = fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.security.totalCritical, 0);
        const isZeroDefect = loadY <= ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && totalCritical === 0;

        // Deterministic certificate hash (no timestamp -> same code = same hash)
        const certificateHash = generateHash(JSON.stringify({
            files: fileMetrics.map(m => ({ f: m.filename, c: m.security.totalCritical, l: m.loadY })),
            loadY, frictionW, omegaT, totalCritical
        }));

        return {
            aggregateCognitive, loadY, frictionW, omegaT,
            isZeroDefect, totalCritical, findings, fileMetrics,
            certificate: { hash: certificateHash, isValid: isZeroDefect && totalCritical === 0 }
        };
    }

    function generateHash(str) {
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
            const char = str.charCodeAt(i);
            hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;
            hash = hash & hash;
        }
        return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // UI CONTROLLER — Home → Import → Progress → Results
    // =========================================================================
    const SUPPORTED = ['js','mjs','cjs','ts','tsx','jsx','html','htm','css','scss','sass','json','yaml','yml','toml'];
    const AUDIT_HISTORY_KEY = 'auditiq-successful-audits-v1';
    const AUDIT_ATTEMPTS_KEY = 'auditiq-audit-attempts-v1';
    const FILTER_PRESETS_KEY = 'auditiq-file-filter-presets-v1';
    let reviewEligible = localStorage.getItem('auditiq-review-eligible') === 'true';
    const LOGO_URI = "data:image/png;base64,";

    // Severity ordering + security pattern catalogue (for clear findings/recs)
    const SEV_ORDER = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 };
    const PATTERNS = [
        { key: 'evalCount', label: 'eval()-Aufruf', sev: 'critical', regex: /\beval\s*\(/, rec: 'eval() vollständig entfernen — es erlaubt beliebige Codeausführung.' },
        { key: 'sqlConcatCount', label: 'SQL per String-Konkatenation', sev: 'critical', regex: /(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE)\b.*\+/i, rec: 'Parametrisierte Queries / Prepared Statements verwenden.' },
        { key: 'hardcodedSecretCount', label: 'Hardcodiertes Passwort/Secret', sev: 'critical', regex: /(?:password|secret|apiKey)\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"]+['"]/i, rec: 'Secrets in Umgebungsvariablen oder einen Secret-Store auslagern.' },
        { key: 'documentWriteCount', label: 'document.write()', sev: 'high', regex: /document\.write/, rec: 'Durch sichere DOM-APIs (createElement/append) ersetzen.' },
        { key: 'innerHTMLCount', label: 'innerHTML-Zuweisung', sev: 'high', regex: /\.innerHTML/, rec: 'textContent nutzen oder Eingaben strikt sanitizen (XSS-Risiko).' },
        { key: 'protoPollutionCount', label: 'Prototype-Pollution', sev: 'high', regex: /__proto__|prototype\s*\[/, rec: '__proto__/prototype-Zugriffe validieren oder Object.create(null) nutzen.' },
        { key: 'pathTraversalCount', label: 'Path-Traversal (../)', sev: 'high', regex: /\.\.\/|\.\.\\/, rec: 'Dateipfade normalisieren und gegen eine Whitelist prüfen.' },
        { key: 'insecureRandomCount', label: 'Math.random() für Zufall', sev: 'medium', regex: /Math\.random\s*\(/, rec: 'Für sicherheitsrelevanten Zufall crypto.getRandomValues() verwenden.' },
        { key: 'postMessageCount', label: 'postMessage() ohne Origin-Check', sev: 'medium', regex: /postMessage\s*\(/, rec: 'Bei postMessage stets die Origin des Absenders prüfen.' },
        { key: 'unsafeDeserializationCount', label: 'JSON.parse() auf Eingaben', sev: 'low', regex: /JSON\.parse\s*\(/, rec: 'Eingaben vor dem Parsen validieren; try/catch einsetzen.' },
        { key: 'locationHashCount', label: 'location.hash-Nutzung', sev: 'low', regex: /location\.hash/, rec: 'Hash-Werte als nicht vertrauenswürdige Eingabe behandeln.' }
    ];

    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const svg = p => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${p}</svg>`;
    const ICON_CHECK = svg('<path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/>');
    const ICON_WARN  = svg('<path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/><path d="M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"/>');

    function showView(name) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
        $('view-' + name).classList.add('active');
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' in window ? 'instant' : 'auto' });
    }

    function readLocal(key) {
        try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '[]'); } catch (_) { return []; }
    }

    function projectKey(files) {
        return files.map(file => file.filename).sort().join(', ');
    }

    function findingSummary(result) {
        const summary = {};
        for (const file of result.fileMetrics) {
            for (const pattern of PATTERNS) {
                const count = file.security[pattern.key] || 0;
                if (count) summary[`${file.filename}|${pattern.key}`] = { file: file.filename, title: pattern.label, severity: pattern.sev, count };
            }
        }
        return summary;
    }

    function renderComparison(result, files) {
        const project = projectKey(files);
        const previous = [...readLocal(AUDIT_ATTEMPTS_KEY)].reverse().find(item => item.project === project && item.findings);
        if (!previous) {
            window.__comparison = null;
            $('comparisonTitle').textContent = 'Erstes Audit dieses Projekts';
            $('comparisonSubtitle').textContent = 'Beim nächsten Audit werden behobene, neue und verbleibende Befunde verglichen.';
            $('comparisonContent').innerHTML = '<div class="compare-empty">Noch keine frühere Version mit diesem Dateibaum gespeichert.</div>';
            return;
        }
        const current = findingSummary(result);
        const previousFindings = previous.findings || {};
        const fixed = [], added = [], open = [];
        for (const [key, finding] of Object.entries(previousFindings)) {
            if (!current[key]) fixed.push(finding); else open.push(current[key]);
        }
        for (const [key, finding] of Object.entries(current)) if (!previousFindings[key]) added.push(finding);
        $('comparisonTitle').textContent = result.isZeroDefect ? 'Verbesserung erfolgreich' : 'Änderungen erkannt';
        $('comparisonSubtitle').textContent = `Verglichen mit dem Audit vom ${new Date(previous.at).toLocaleString('de-DE')}`;
        window.__comparison = { previousAt: previous.at, fixed, added, open };
        const column = (kind, label, items) => `<div class="compare-column"><div class="compare-label ${kind}">${label}</div><div class="compare-count" data-testid="comparison-${kind}-count">${items.length}</div>${items.length ? items.slice(0, 5).map(item => `<div class="compare-item">${escapeHtml(item.title)} · ${escapeHtml(item.file)}</div>`).join('') : '<div class="compare-item">Keine</div>'}</div>`;
        $('comparisonContent').innerHTML = `<div class="comparison-grid">${column('fixed', 'Behoben', fixed)}${column('new', 'Neu', added)}${column('open', 'Offen', open)}</div>`;
    }

    function renderHistory() {
        const history = readLocal(AUDIT_HISTORY_KEY);
        $('successfulAuditCount').textContent = String(history.length);
        $('historyList').innerHTML = history.length ? history.map((item, index) => `
            <article class="history-item" data-testid="successful-audit-${index}">
                <div><div class="history-title">${escapeHtml(item.project)}</div><div class="history-meta">${escapeHtml(item.date)} · ${item.files} Datei(en)</div></div>
                <div class="history-stat"><strong>${item.lines}</strong>Codezeilen</div>
                <div class="history-stat"><strong>${item.score}</strong>W(t)</div>
                <div class="history-stat pf-ok"><strong>✓</strong>Bestanden</div>
            </article>`).join('') : '<div class="history-empty">Noch kein erfolgreiches Audit. Prüfen und verbessern Sie ein Projekt, um es hier lokal zu dokumentieren.</div>';
    }

    async function loadReviews() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/reviews');
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('reviews unavailable');
            const reviews = await response.json();
            $('reviewsList').innerHTML = reviews.length ? reviews.map((review, index) => `
                <article class="review" data-testid="review-${index}"><div class="review-top"><span class="review-name">${escapeHtml(review.name)}</span><span class="review-stars">${'★'.repeat(review.rating)}</span></div><p class="review-text">${escapeHtml(review.text)}</p></article>`).join('') : '<div class="history-empty">Noch keine Rezensionen. Die erste erfolgreiche Verbesserung kann hier geteilt werden.</div>';
        } catch (_) {
            $('reviewsList').innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty">Rezensionen sind vorübergehend nicht verfügbar.</div>';
        }
    }

    function statusValue(id, label, state) {
        const dotClass = state === 'ok' ? '' : (state === 'warn' ? 'warn' : 'down');
        $(id).innerHTML = `<span class="status-dot ${dotClass}"></span>${escapeHtml(label)}`;
    }

    async function loadDiagnostics() {
        statusValue('backendStatus', 'Prüfe…', 'warn');
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/health/config', { cache: 'no-store' });
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('diagnostics unavailable');
            const diagnostics = await response.json();
            statusValue('backendStatus', diagnostics.backend_healthy ? 'Online' : 'Nicht verfügbar', diagnostics.backend_healthy ? 'ok' : 'down');
            if (diagnostics.storage_mode === 'mongodb') {
                statusValue('storageStatus', 'Atlas verbunden', 'ok');
                $('storageDetail').textContent = 'Öffentliche Rezensionen werden dauerhaft in MongoDB Atlas gespeichert.';
            } else {
                statusValue('storageStatus', 'Lokaler Fallback', 'warn');
                $('storageDetail').textContent = 'Entwicklungs-/Offline-Modus: Rezensionen liegen in der lokalen JSON-Datei.';
            }
            const config = diagnostics.config || {};
            const complete = config.mongo_url_configured && config.db_name_configured && config.cors_origins_configured;
            statusValue('configStatus', complete ? 'Bereit' : 'Unvollständig', complete ? 'ok' : 'warn');
            const chip = (label, ok) => `<span class="config-chip">${ok ? '✓' : '○'} ${label}</span>`;
            $('configChips').innerHTML = chip('Mongo-Verbindung konfiguriert', config.mongo_url_configured) + chip('Datenbankname konfiguriert', config.db_name_configured) + chip('CORS konfiguriert', config.cors_origins_configured) + chip('Produktionsmodus', config.production_mode) + '<span class="config-chip">Keine Werte offengelegt</span>';
            $('statusCheckedAt').textContent = `Zuletzt sicher geprüft: ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('de-DE')}`;
        } catch (_) {
            statusValue('backendStatus', 'Nicht erreichbar', 'down');
            statusValue('storageStatus', 'Unbekannt', 'down');
            statusValue('configStatus', 'Nicht prüfbar', 'down');
            $('statusCheckedAt').textContent = 'Status konnte nicht geladen werden.';
            $('configChips').innerHTML = '<span class="config-chip">Keine geheimen Werte offengelegt</span>';
        }
    }

    function updateReviewEligibility() {
        $('reviewSubmitBtn').disabled = !reviewEligible;
        $('reviewName').disabled = !reviewEligible;
        $('reviewRating').disabled = !reviewEligible;
        $('reviewText').disabled = !reviewEligible;
        $('reviewLockText').textContent = reviewEligible ? 'Freigeschaltet: Ihre erfolgreiche Codeverbesserung wurde lokal erkannt.' : 'Nach einem zunächst fehlerhaften und anschließend bestandenen Audit desselben Projekts freigeschaltet.';
    }

    function storeAuditOutcome(r, files) {
        const attempts = readLocal(AUDIT_ATTEMPTS_KEY);
        const project = projectKey(files);
        const passed = r.isZeroDefect && r.totalCritical === 0;
        const previousFailed = attempts.some(a => a.project === project && !a.passed);
        attempts.push({ project, passed, at: new Date().toISOString(), findings: findingSummary(r), lines: r.fileMetrics.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.totalLines, 0), score: Math.max(0, Math.round(100 - Math.min(100, r.totalCritical * 12 + r.loadY * 8))) });
        localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_ATTEMPTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(attempts.slice(-50)));
        if (!passed) return;
        if (previousFailed) {
            reviewEligible = true;
            localStorage.setItem('auditiq-review-eligible', 'true');
        }
        const history = readLocal(AUDIT_HISTORY_KEY);
        const entry = { project, files: r.fileMetrics.length, lines: r.fileMetrics.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.totalLines, 0), score: r.loadY.toFixed(2), date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('de-DE'), hash: r.certificate.hash };
        const withoutDuplicate = history.filter(item => item.hash !== entry.hash);
        localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify([entry, ...withoutDuplicate].slice(0, 30)));
        renderHistory();
        updateReviewEligibility();
    }
    function toast(msg) {
        const t = $('toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
        clearTimeout(toast._t); toast._t = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
    }
    const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
    function readFile(file) {
        return new Promise((res, rej) => {
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = () => res(r.result);
            r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
            r.readAsText(file);
        });
    }

    async function inflateRaw(bytes) {
        if (!('DecompressionStream' in window)) throw new Error('ZIP-Kompression wird von diesem Browser nicht unterstützt.');
        const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'));
        return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
    }

    async function extractZip(file) {
        const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const view = new DataView(buffer);
        let eocd = -1;
        for (let i = Math.max(0, buffer.byteLength - 65557); i <= buffer.byteLength - 22; i++) {
            if (view.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50) eocd = i;
        }
        if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('Ungültiges ZIP-Archiv.');
        const entries = view.getUint16(eocd + 10, true);
        let offset = view.getUint32(eocd + 16, true);
        let totalSize = 0;
        const files = [];
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
        for (let index = 0; index < entries && index < 500; index++) {
            if (view.getUint32(offset, true) !== 0x02014b50) throw new Error('ZIP-Verzeichnis ist beschädigt.');
            const flags = view.getUint16(offset + 8, true);
            const method = view.getUint16(offset + 10, true);
            const compressedSize = view.getUint32(offset + 20, true);
            const uncompressedSize = view.getUint32(offset + 24, true);
            const nameLength = view.getUint16(offset + 28, true);
            const extraLength = view.getUint16(offset + 30, true);
            const commentLength = view.getUint16(offset + 32, true);
            const localOffset = view.getUint32(offset + 42, true);
            const filename = decoder.decode(new Uint8Array(buffer, offset + 46, nameLength));
            offset += 46 + nameLength + extraLength + commentLength;
            const ext = (filename.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
            if (filename.endsWith('/') || filename.startsWith('__MACOSX/') || !SUPPORTED.includes(ext)) continue;
            if (flags & 1) throw new Error('Passwortgeschützte ZIP-Dateien werden nicht unterstützt.');
            totalSize += uncompressedSize;
            if (uncompressedSize > 5_000_000 || totalSize > 20_000_000) throw new Error('ZIP-Projekt ist zu groß (max. 5 MB pro Datei, 20 MB gesamt).');
            if (view.getUint32(localOffset, true) !== 0x04034b50) throw new Error('ZIP-Dateieintrag ist beschädigt.');
            const localNameLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 26, true);
            const localExtraLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 28, true);
            const dataStart = localOffset + 30 + localNameLength + localExtraLength;
            const compressed = new Uint8Array(buffer, dataStart, compressedSize);
            let raw;
            if (method === 0) raw = compressed;
            else if (method === 8) raw = await inflateRaw(compressed);
            else continue;
            files.push({ filename, content: decoder.decode(raw), language: getLanguage(filename) });
        }
        return files;
    }

    // ---- Demo (bundled sample code) ----

        "  let q = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=' + input;",
        "  const d = JSON.parse(input);",
        "  if(input){ if(d){ if(q){ if(password){ if(out){ console.log(1); } } } } }",
        "  for(let i=0;i<9;i++){ for(let j=0;j<9;j++){ for(let k=0;k<9;k++){ console.log(i); } } }",
        "  const r = Math.random();",
        "  obj.__proto__.polluted = true;",
        "  const p = '../../etc/passwd';",
        "  return password;",
        "}"
    ].join("\n");
    const SAMPLE_CLEAN = "export function add(a, b) { return a + b; }\nexport function greet(name) { return 'Hallo ' + name; }";

    async function runDemo() {
        const loaded = [
            { filename: 'beispiel_unsicher.js', content: SAMPLE_VULN, language: 'javascript' },
            { filename: 'beispiel_sauber.js', content: SAMPLE_CLEAN, language: 'javascript' }
        ];
        showView('progress');
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Dateien werden eingelesen…';
        setProgress(0, 'Starte…');
        $('progList').innerHTML = loaded.map((f, i) =>
            `<div class="pfile"><span class="pfile-name">${escapeHtml(f.filename)}</span><span class="pfile-state" id="pfs-${i}">Warten…</span></div>`).join('');
        for (let i = 0; i < loaded.length; i++) {
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="reading">Lese…</span>';
            await sleep(260);
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="ok">✓ Gelesen</span>';
            setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / loaded.length) * 100), `${i + 1} / ${loaded.length} Dateien gelesen`);
        }
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Analyse läuft…';
        setProgress(100, 'Analysiere Muster…');
        await sleep(450);
        const results = analyzeFiles(loaded);
        window.__lastResults = results; window.__lastFiles = loaded;
        renderResults(results);
        showView('results');

    // ---- Import wiring ----
    const dropzone = $('dropzone'), fileInput = $('fileInput');
    const codeInput = $('codeInput'), pasteFilename = $('pasteFilename'), pasteLanguage = $('pasteLanguage');
    $('browseBtn').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); fileInput.click(); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => { if (e.target.files.length) startAudit(e.target.files); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.add('drag'); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropzone.classList.remove('drag'));
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
        e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.remove('drag');
        const items = e.dataTransfer.files;
        if (items && items.length) startAudit(items);
    });

    $('pasteAuditBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const content = codeInput.value;
        if (!content.trim()) { toast('Bitte zuerst Code einfügen.'); codeInput.focus(); return; }
        const filename = (pasteFilename.value.trim() || 'eingefuegter_code.js');
        const language = pasteLanguage.value;
        runPastedAudit({ filename, content, language });
    });
    $('pasteClearBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        codeInput.value = '';
        codeInput.focus();
    });

    async function runPastedAudit(file) {
        showView('progress');
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Eingefügter Code wird geprüft…';
        $('progDesc').textContent = 'Der Code bleibt lokal auf diesem Gerät und wird deterministisch analysiert.';
        $('progList').innerHTML = `<div class="pfile"><span class="pfile-name">${escapeHtml(file.filename)}</span><span class="pfile-state" id="pfs-paste"><span class="reading">Prüfe…</span></span></div>`;
        setProgress(35, 'Code übernommen');
        await sleep(260);
        $('pfs-paste').innerHTML = '<span class="ok">✓ Lokal gelesen</span>';
        setProgress(100, 'Analysiere Muster…');
        await sleep(360);
        const loaded = [file];
        const results = analyzeFiles(loaded);
        window.__lastResults = results;
        window.__lastFiles = loaded;
        renderResults(results);
        showView('results');
    }

    // ---- Main flow ----
    async function startAudit(fileList) {
        const all = Array.from(fileList);
        const arr = all.filter(f => {
            const ext = (f.name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase();
            return SUPPORTED.includes(ext) || ext === 'zip';
        });
        if (arr.length === 0) { toast('Keine unterstützten Dateien gefunden.'); return; }

        showView('progress');
        setProgress(0, 'Starte…');
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Dateien werden eingelesen…';
        $('progList').innerHTML = arr.map((f, i) =>
            `<div class="pfile"><span class="pfile-name">${escapeHtml(f.name)}</span><span class="pfile-state" id="pfs-${i}">Warten…</span></div>`
        ).join('');

        const loaded = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="reading">Lese…</span>';
            try {
                if (arr[i].name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.zip')) {
                    const extracted = await extractZip(arr[i]);
                    loaded.push(...extracted);
                    $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = `<span class="ok">✓ ${extracted.length} Code-Dateien</span>`;
                } else {
                    const content = await readFile(arr[i]);
                    loaded.push({ filename: arr[i].name, content, language: getLanguage(arr[i].name) });
                    $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="ok">✓ Gelesen</span>';
                }
            } catch (err) {
                $('pfs-' + i).textContent = 'Fehler';
                toast(err.message || 'Datei konnte nicht gelesen werden.');
            }
            setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / arr.length) * 100), `${i + 1} / ${arr.length} Dateien gelesen`);
            await sleep(140);
        }

        if (!loaded.length) { showView('import'); toast('Keine unterstützten Code-Dateien im Projekt gefunden.'); return; }
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Analyse läuft…';
        $('progDesc').textContent = 'Feldtheorie-Metriken werden berechnet und Sicherheitsmuster geprüft.';
        setProgress(100, 'Analysiere Muster…');
        await sleep(450);

        const results = analyzeFiles(loaded);
        window.__lastResults = results;
        window.__lastFiles = loaded;
        renderResults(results);
        showView('results');
        $('progDesc').textContent = 'Der Code wird lokal gelesen und für die Analyse vorbereitet.';
    }

    function setProgress(pct, label) {
        $('progBar').style.width = pct + '%';
        $('progPct').textContent = pct + '%';
        $('progLabel').textContent = label;
    }

    // ---- Results rendering ----
    function renderResults(r) {
        const pass = r.isZeroDefect && r.totalCritical === 0;
        if (window.__lastFiles) renderComparison(r, window.__lastFiles);

        // Verdict
        const v = $('verdict');
        v.classList.toggle('fail', !pass);
        $('verdictBadge').innerHTML = pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN;
        $('verdictTitle').textContent = pass ? 'Zero-Defect zertifiziert' : `${r.totalCritical} kritische Befunde`;
        $('verdictDesc').textContent = pass
            ? 'Keine kritischen Sicherheitsmuster erkannt — der Code erfüllt die Zero-Defect-Schwelle.'
            : 'Es wurden sicherheits- oder qualitätsrelevante Muster gefunden. Details siehe unten.';

        // Metrics
        $('metrics').innerHTML = [
            metric('Kritische Befunde', r.totalCritical, r.totalCritical > 0 ? 'crit' : 'ok'),
            metric('Dateien geprüft', r.fileMetrics.length, ''),
            metric('W(t) Last', r.loadY.toFixed(2), r.loadY > WARNING_THRESHOLD ? 'crit' : 'ok'),
            metric('Ω(t) Feld', r.omegaT.toFixed(1), '')
        ].join('');

        // Detailed findings per pattern per file
        const findings = [];
        for (const fm of r.fileMetrics) {
            for (const p of PATTERNS) {
                const c = fm.security[p.key] || 0;
                if (c > 0) findings.push({ sev: p.sev, title: p.label, file: fm.filename, count: c, lines: fm.lineHits[p.key] || [], rec: p.rec });
            }
            if (fm.performance.cyclomaticComplexity > 15)
                findings.push({ sev: 'medium', title: 'Hohe zyklomatische Komplexität', file: fm.filename, count: fm.performance.cyclomaticComplexity, rec: 'Funktionen aufteilen und vereinfachen (Ziel < 15).' });
            if (fm.performance.nestingDepth > 5)
                findings.push({ sev: 'medium', title: 'Tiefe Verschachtelung', file: fm.filename, count: fm.performance.nestingDepth, rec: 'Verschachtelung durch Early Returns reduzieren.' });
        }
        findings.sort((a, b) => SEV_ORDER[a.sev] - SEV_ORDER[b.sev]);

        $('findingsCount').textContent = findings.length ? `${findings.length} gesamt` : '';
        $('findingsList').innerHTML = findings.length ? findings.map((f, index) => `
            <div class="finding ${f.sev}" data-testid="finding-${index}">
                <span class="sev-tag ${f.sev}">${f.sev.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <div>
                    <div class="finding-title">${escapeHtml(f.title)}</div>
                    <div class="finding-file">${escapeHtml(f.file)}${f.lines.length ? ` · Zeile ${f.lines.join(', ')}` : ''}</div>
                    ${f.lines.length ? `<div class="finding-lines">${f.lines.map(line => `<span class="line-chip">ZEILE ${line}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
                    <div class="finding-rec">${escapeHtml(f.rec)}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="finding-count">${f.count}×</div>
            </div>`).join('')
            : `<div class="empty">${ICON_CHECK}<span>Keine Befunde — sauber!</span></div>`;

        // Recommendations (aggregated & de-duplicated by pattern)
        const recMap = new Map();
        for (const fm of r.fileMetrics) {
            for (const p of PATTERNS) {
                const c = fm.security[p.key] || 0;
                if (c > 0) recMap.set(p.key, { sev: p.sev, title: p.label + ' beheben', body: p.rec, n: (recMap.get(p.key)?.n || 0) + c });
            }
        }
        const recs = [...recMap.values()].sort((a, b) => SEV_ORDER[a.sev] - SEV_ORDER[b.sev]);
        $('recsCount').textContent = recs.length ? `${recs.length} Maßnahmen` : '';
        $('recsList').innerHTML = recs.length ? recs.map(rc => `
            <div class="rec">
                <span class="rec-dot ${rc.sev}"></span>
                <div>
                    <div class="rec-title">${escapeHtml(rc.title)} <span style="color:var(--faint);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;">(${rc.n}×)</span></div>
                    <div class="rec-body">${escapeHtml(rc.body)}</div>
                </div>
            </div>`).join('')
            : `<div class="empty">${ICON_CHECK}<span>Keine Maßnahmen erforderlich. Weiter so.</span></div>`;

        // Filterable file tree
        const languages = [...new Set(r.fileMetrics.map(file => file.language))].sort();
        $('languageFilter').innerHTML = '<option value="all">Alle Sprachen</option>' + languages.map(language => `<option value="${escapeHtml(language)}">${escapeHtml(language)}</option>`).join('');
        $('fileSearch').value = '';
        $('languageFilter').value = 'all';
        $('severityFilter').value = 'all';
        renderFileTree(r.fileMetrics);

        // Certificate (with timestamped signature + owner)
        const OWNER = 'Patrick Frank Buckreus';
        const now = new Date();
        const stampISO = now.toISOString();
        const stampHuman = now.toLocaleString('de-DE', { dateStyle: 'long', timeStyle: 'medium' });
        const signedHash = generateHash(r.certificate.hash + '|' + stampISO + '|' + OWNER + '|05.01.1996');
        window.__cert = { hash: r.certificate.hash, signedHash, stampISO, stampHuman, owner: OWNER, valid: r.certificate.isValid };

        const cert = $('certCard');
        cert.classList.toggle('fail', !pass);
        const totalLines = r.fileMetrics.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.totalLines, 0);
        const auditScore = Math.max(0, Math.round(100 - Math.min(100, r.totalCritical * 12 + r.loadY * 8)));
        const projectName = (window.__lastFiles || []).length === 1 ? window.__lastFiles[0].filename : `${r.fileMetrics.length} Dateien / Projekt`;
        $('certSeal').innerHTML = pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN;
        $('certProject').textContent = projectName;
        $('certProjectMeta').textContent = `${r.fileMetrics.length} Datei(en) · ${totalLines} geprüfte Codezeilen · vollständig lokal`;
        $('certScore').textContent = String(auditScore);
        $('certTop').innerHTML = (pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN) +
            `<span class="t">${pass ? 'AUDITIQ-ZERTIFIKAT' : 'AUDITIQ-ZERTIFIKAT — NICHT BESTANDEN'}</span>`;
        $('certGrid').innerHTML = [
            certItem('Status', pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT ✓' : 'BEFUNDE VORHANDEN ✗', pass ? 'ok' : 'no'),
            certItem('Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)', r.certificate.hash, ''),
            certItem('Zeitstempel', stampHuman, ''),
            certItem('Signatur-Hash (mit Datum & Uhrzeit)', signedHash, pass ? 'ok' : ''),
            certItem('Feldlast W(t)', r.loadY.toFixed(4), ''),
            certItem('Feldstärke Ω(t)', r.omegaT.toFixed(4), ''),
            certItem('Inhaber / Copyright', '© Patrick Frank Buckreus (05.01.1996)', '')
        ].join('');
        renderCertificateQr();
        if (window.__lastFiles) storeAuditOutcome(r, window.__lastFiles);
    }

    function renderFileTree(metrics) {
        const search = $('fileSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
        const language = $('languageFilter').value;
        const severity = $('severityFilter').value;
        const filtered = metrics.filter(file => {
            const state = file.security.totalCritical > 0 ? 'critical' : (file.isWarning ? 'warning' : 'clean');
            return (!search || file.filename.toLowerCase().includes(search)) && (language === 'all' || file.language === language) && (severity === 'all' || state === severity);
        });
        $('visibleFileCount').textContent = `${filtered.length} von ${metrics.length} Dateien`;
        $('fileFilterCount').textContent = `${metrics.length} gesamt`;
        $('perFileBody').innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map((file, index) => {
            const parts = file.filename.split('/');
            const name = parts.pop();
            const folder = parts.length ? `<span class="file-path-folder">${escapeHtml(parts.join('/') + '/')}</span>` : '';
            return `<tr data-testid="file-tree-row-${index}"><td>${folder}<span class="file-path-name">${escapeHtml(name)}</span></td><td>${escapeHtml(file.language)}</td><td>${file.totalLines}</td><td>${file.security.totalCritical}</td><td>${file.loadY.toFixed(2)}</td><td class="${file.isZeroDefect ? 'pf-ok' : 'pf-no'}">${file.isZeroDefect ? '✓ Sauber' : '✗ Befunde'}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="6">Keine Dateien entsprechen den Filtern.</td></tr>';
    }

    function renderFilterPresets() {
        const presets = readLocal(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY);
        $('filterPresetSelect').innerHTML = '<option value="">Gespeicherten Filter wählen…</option>' + presets.map((preset, index) => `<option value="${index}">${escapeHtml(preset.name)}</option>`).join('');
    }

    function applyFilterPreset(index) {
        const preset = readLocal(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY)[Number(index)];
        if (!preset || !window.__lastResults) return;
        $('fileSearch').value = preset.search || '';
        $('languageFilter').value = [...$('languageFilter').options].some(option => option.value === preset.language) ? preset.language : 'all';
        $('severityFilter').value = preset.severity || 'all';
        renderFileTree(window.__lastResults.fileMetrics);
    }

    function encodeCertificate(payload) {
        const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
        let binary = '';
        for (const byte of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(byte);
        return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/g, '');
    }

    function certificatePayload() {
        const result = window.__lastResults, cert = window.__cert;
        if (!result || !cert) return null;
        return { v: 1, pass: result.isZeroDefect && result.totalCritical === 0, files: result.fileMetrics.length, lines: result.fileMetrics.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.totalLines, 0), score: Number($('certScore').textContent), hash: cert.hash, signature: cert.signedHash, at: cert.stampISO };
    }

    function certificateLink() {
        const payload = certificatePayload();
        return payload ? `${location.origin}${location.pathname}?certificate=${encodeCertificate(payload)}` : '';
    }

    function renderCertificateQr() {
        const link = certificateLink();
        if (!link) return;
        $('certShareLink').value = link;
        if (typeof qrcode !== 'function') { $('certQr').textContent = 'QR nicht verfügbar'; return; }
        const qr = qrcode(0, 'M');
        qr.addData(link);
        qr.make();
        $('certQr').innerHTML = qr.createSvgTag(4, 0);
    }

    function decodeCertificate(value) {
        const base64 = value.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
        const binary = atob(base64 + '='.repeat((4 - base64.length % 4) % 4));
        return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(binary, char => char.charCodeAt(0))));
    }

    function showSharedCertificate(payload) {
        if (payload.v !== 1 || typeof payload.hash !== 'string' || typeof payload.score !== 'number') throw new Error('Ungültiges Zertifikat');
        const pass = Boolean(payload.pass);
        $('sharedCertCard').classList.toggle('fail', !pass);
        $('sharedCertSeal').innerHTML = pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN;
        $('sharedCertScore').textContent = String(payload.score);
        $('sharedCertMeta').textContent = `${payload.files} Datei(en) · ${payload.lines} geprüfte Codezeilen · kein Quellcode enthalten`;
        $('sharedCertStatus').innerHTML = (pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN) + `<span class="t">${pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT ZERTIFIZIERT' : 'AUDIT MIT BEFUNDEN'}</span>`;
        $('sharedCertGrid').innerHTML = [certItem('Status', pass ? 'BESTANDEN ✓' : 'NICHT BESTANDEN', pass ? 'ok' : 'no'), certItem('Inhalts-Signatur', payload.hash, ''), certItem('Signatur-Hash', payload.signature, ''), certItem('Zeitstempel', new Date(payload.at).toLocaleString('de-DE'), '')].join('');
        showView('shared');
    }

    function metric(label, value, cls) {
        return `<div class="metric"><div class="metric-label">${label}</div><div class="metric-value ${cls}">${value}</div></div>`;
    }
    function certItem(k, v, cls) {
        return `<div class="cert-item"><div class="k">${k}</div><div class="v ${cls}">${escapeHtml(String(v))}</div></div>`;
    }
    function escapeHtml(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
    }

    // ---- Actions ----
    $('homeNavBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { renderHistory(); loadReviews(); showView('home'); });
    $('auditNavBtn').addEventListener('click', () => showView('import'));
    $('statusNavBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { showView('home'); loadDiagnostics(); setTimeout(() => $('statusSection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }), 50); });
    $('refreshStatusBtn').addEventListener('click', loadDiagnostics);
    $('heroAuditBtn').addEventListener('click', () => showView('import'));
    $('historyJumpBtn').addEventListener('click', () => $('historySection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }));
    $('clearHistoryBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { localStorage.removeItem(AUDIT_HISTORY_KEY); renderHistory(); toast('Lokale Erfolgshistorie gelöscht.'); });
    $('newAuditBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { fileInput.value = ''; showView('import'); });
    $('reviewForm').addEventListener('submit', async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!reviewEligible) return;
        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/reviews', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ name: $('reviewName').value.trim(), rating: Number($('reviewRating').value), text: $('reviewText').value.trim() }) });
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('submit failed');
            $('reviewForm').reset();
            reviewEligible = false;
            localStorage.removeItem('auditiq-review-eligible');
            updateReviewEligibility();
            await loadReviews();
            toast('Rezension veröffentlicht. Danke!');
        } catch (_) { toast('Rezension konnte nicht veröffentlicht werden.'); }
    });
    $('demoBtn').addEventListener('click', runDemo);
    (function(){
        const dp = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('demo');
        if (dp === 'instant') {
            const loaded = [
                { filename: 'beispiel_unsicher.js', content: SAMPLE_VULN, language: 'javascript' },
                { filename: 'beispiel_sauber.js', content: SAMPLE_CLEAN, language: 'javascript' }
            ];
            const r = analyzeFiles(loaded); window.__lastResults = r; window.__lastFiles = loaded;
            renderResults(r); showView('results');
        } else if (dp) { runDemo(); }
    })();
    $('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', printReport);
    $('certBtn').addEventListener('click', printCertificate);
    $('fileSearch').addEventListener('input', () => window.__lastResults && renderFileTree(window.__lastResults.fileMetrics));
    $('languageFilter').addEventListener('change', () => window.__lastResults && renderFileTree(window.__lastResults.fileMetrics));
    $('severityFilter').addEventListener('change', () => window.__lastResults && renderFileTree(window.__lastResults.fileMetrics));
    $('filterPresetSelect').addEventListener('change', event => applyFilterPreset(event.target.value));
    $('saveFilterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!window.__lastResults) return;
        const name = window.prompt('Name für diesen Filterfavoriten:');
        if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
        const presets = readLocal(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY);
        presets.push({ name: name.trim().slice(0, 40), search: $('fileSearch').value, language: $('languageFilter').value, severity: $('severityFilter').value });
        localStorage.setItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY, JSON.stringify(presets.slice(-12)));
        renderFilterPresets();
        $('filterPresetSelect').value = String(Math.min(presets.length, 12) - 1);
        toast('Filterfavorit lokal gespeichert.');
    });
    $('deleteFilterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number($('filterPresetSelect').value);
        if (!Number.isInteger(index) || $('filterPresetSelect').value === '') return;
        const presets = readLocal(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY);
        presets.splice(index, 1);
        localStorage.setItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY, JSON.stringify(presets));
        renderFilterPresets();
        toast('Filterfavorit gelöscht.');
    });
    $('shareCertBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const link = certificateLink();
        if (!link) return;
        try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); toast('Datenschutzfreundlicher Zertifikatslink kopiert.'); }
        catch (_) { window.prompt('Zertifikatslink kopieren:', link); }
    });
    $('sharedHomeBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { history.replaceState({}, '', location.pathname); showView('home'); });
    renderHistory();
    renderFilterPresets();
    updateReviewEligibility();
    loadReviews();
    loadDiagnostics();
    const sharedParam = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('certificate');
    if (sharedParam) {
        try { showSharedCertificate(decodeCertificate(sharedParam)); }
        catch (_) { toast('Der Zertifikatslink ist ungültig.'); }
    }

    function openPrint(title, bodyHtml) {
        const w = window.open('', '_blank');
        if (!w) { toast('Bitte Pop-ups erlauben, um das PDF zu erzeugen.'); return; }
        const css = "*{box-sizing:border-box}body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:#17170F;margin:0;padding:48px;line-height:1.5}"
            + ".doc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;border-bottom:2px solid #17170F;padding-bottom:18px;margin-bottom:28px}"
            + ".doc-head img{height:58px;width:auto}.doc-head .n{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.02em}"
            + ".doc-head .s{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.16em;color:#6B6B60;margin-top:3px}"
            + "h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 14px}.badge{display:inline-block;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;font-size:13px}"
            + ".badge.ok{background:#0E7C5A}.badge.no{background:#C0362C}"
            + "table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin:14px 0}td,th{border:1px solid #E4E3DA;padding:9px 11px;text-align:left}th{background:#FAFAF7;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6B60}"
            + ".kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;gap:8px 20px;font-size:14px;margin:6px 0}.kv .k{color:#6B6B60}.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;word-break:break-all}"
            + ".ok{color:#0E7C5A;font-weight:700}.no{color:#C0362C;font-weight:700}"
            + ".cprt{margin-top:36px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #E4E3DA;font-size:12px;color:#6B6B60}"
            + "@media print{body{padding:24px}}";
        const doc = '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>' + title + '</title><style>' + css + '</style></head><body>'
            + '<div class="doc-head"><img src="' + LOGO_URI + '" alt="AuditIQ"><div><div class="n">AuditIQ</div><div class="s">DETERMINISTIC CODE AUDIT</div></div></div>'
            + bodyHtml
            + '<div class="cprt">© 2026 Patrick Frank Buckreus (geb. 05.01.1996) · AuditIQ · Alle Rechte vorbehalten.</div>'
            + '<scr' + 'ipt>window.onload=function(){setTimeout(function(){window.focus();window.print();},350);}</scr' + 'ipt>'
            + '</body></html>';
        w.document.open(); w.document.write(doc); w.document.close();
        toast('PDF-Ansicht geöffnet — im Druckdialog „Als PDF speichern“ wählen.');
    }

    function printReport() {
        const r = window.__lastResults, c = window.__cert || {}; if (!r) return;
        const pass = r.isZeroDefect && r.totalCritical === 0;
        const rows = r.fileMetrics.map(m =>
            '<tr><td class="mono">' + escapeHtml(m.filename) + '</td><td>' + m.language + '</td><td>' + m.totalLines + '</td><td>' + m.security.totalCritical + '</td><td>' + m.loadY.toFixed(2) + '</td><td class="' + (m.isZeroDefect ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (m.isZeroDefect ? 'Sauber' : 'Befunde') + '</td></tr>').join('');
        const comparison = window.__comparison;
        const comparisonHtml = comparison ? '<h1 style="margin-top:28px">Vergleich zur vorherigen Version</h1>'
            + '<table><thead><tr><th>Behoben</th><th>Neu</th><th>Offen</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="ok">' + comparison.fixed.length + '</td><td class="no">' + comparison.added.length + '</td><td>' + comparison.open.length + '</td></tr></tbody></table>'
            + '<div class="kv"><span class="k">Behobene Befunde</span><span>' + escapeHtml(comparison.fixed.map(item => item.title + ' · ' + item.file).join('; ') || 'Keine') + '</span><span class="k">Neue Befunde</span><span>' + escapeHtml(comparison.added.map(item => item.title + ' · ' + item.file).join('; ') || 'Keine') + '</span><span class="k">Offene Befunde</span><span>' + escapeHtml(comparison.open.map(item => item.title + ' · ' + item.file).join('; ') || 'Keine') + '</span></div>' : '';
        const body = '<h1>Code-Audit Bericht</h1>'
            + '<span class="badge ' + (pass ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT ZERTIFIZIERT' : r.totalCritical + ' KRITISCHE BEFUNDE') + '</span>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:20px"><span class="k">Zeitstempel</span><span>' + escapeHtml(c.stampHuman || '') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Dateien</span><span>' + r.fileMetrics.length + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldlast W(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.loadY.toFixed(4) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldstärke Ω(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.omegaT.toFixed(4) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)</span><span class="mono">' + r.certificate.hash + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Signatur-Hash (Datum & Uhrzeit)</span><span class="mono">' + (c.signedHash || '') + '</span></div>'
            + '<h1 style="margin-top:28px">Datei-Übersicht</h1>'
            + '<table><thead><tr><th>Datei</th><th>Sprache</th><th>Zeilen</th><th>Kritisch</th><th>W(t)</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>'
            + comparisonHtml;
        openPrint('AuditIQ Bericht', body);
    }

    function printCertificate() {
        const r = window.__lastResults, c = window.__cert || {}; if (!r) return;
        const pass = r.certificate.isValid;
        const body = '<h1>Seinsmodus-Zertifikat</h1>'
            + '<span class="badge ' + (pass ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT · GÜLTIG' : 'NICHT BESTANDEN') + '</span>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:22px">'
            + '<span class="k">Inhaber</span><span>Patrick Frank Buckreus (geb. 05.01.1996)</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Zeitstempel</span><span>' + escapeHtml(c.stampHuman || '') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)</span><span class="mono">' + r.certificate.hash + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Signatur-Hash (Datum & Uhrzeit)</span><span class="mono">' + (c.signedHash || '') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldlast W(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.loadY.toFixed(6) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldstärke Ω(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.omegaT.toFixed(6) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Dateien</span><span>' + r.fileMetrics.length + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Kritische Befunde</span><span>' + r.totalCritical + '</span></div>';
        openPrint('AuditIQ Zertifikat', body);
    }

    console.log('AuditIQ bereit — zero-egress, client-side engine active. © Patrick Frank Buckreus');
</script>
</body>
</html>
