<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AuditIQ — Deterministisches Code-Audit</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="favicon.png">
<style>
    :root {
        --bg: #F5F5F1;
        --paper: #FFFFFF;
        --ink: #17170F;
        --muted: #6B6B60;
        --faint: #9A9A8E;
        --line: #E4E3DA;
        --line-strong: #D2D1C5;
        --accent: #0E7C5A;
        --accent-soft: #E6F4EE;
        --critical: #C0362C;
        --high: #C8571B;
        --medium: #B7861A;
        --low: #0E7C5A;
        --mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
        --sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
        --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,23,15,0.04), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(23,23,15,0.18);
    }
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; }
    body {
        font-family: var(--sans);
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--ink);
        line-height: 1.5;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    ::selection { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
    a { color: inherit; }

    /* ---------- Top bar ---------- */
    .topbar {
        position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
        display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 14px 28px;
        background: rgba(245,245,241,0.85);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; }
    .brand-img { height: 52px; width: auto; display: block; }
    .brand-name { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .brand-sub { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--faint); }
    .egress-badge {
        display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
        font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft);
        padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #CBE7DA;
    }
    .egress-badge svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
    .brand-img { height: 38px; width: auto; display: block; }

    /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
    .site-footer {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
        background: var(--paper);
        padding: 22px 28px;
        text-align: center;
    }
    .site-footer .cprt { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
    .site-footer .cprt strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
    .site-footer .meta { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--faint); margin-top: 5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

    /* ---------- Views ---------- */
    .view { display: none; }
    .view.active { display: block; animation: fade 0.35s ease both; }
    @keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    .wrap { max-width: 920px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 56px 28px 80px; }
    .wrap-wide { max-width: 1040px; }

    /* ---------- Import view ---------- */
    .import-head { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    h1 { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.08; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .lead { font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 56ch; margin: 0 auto; }

    .dropzone {
        background: var(--paper);
        border: 2px dashed var(--line-strong);
        padding: 60px 32px;
        text-align: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: border-color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }
    .dropzone:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: #FCFDFC; }
    .dropzone.drag { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); transform: scale(1.005); }
    .dz-ico {
        width: 58px; height: 58px; margin: 0 auto 20px;
        display: grid; place-items: center;
        background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .dz-ico svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
    .dz-title { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .dz-hint { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 22px; }
    .btn {
        display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
        font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
        padding: 12px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: #fff;
        cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
    }
    .btn:hover { opacity: 0.88; }
    .btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--line-strong); }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--paper); border-color: var(--ink); opacity: 1; }

    .formats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 34px; }
    .chip { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 5px 10px; }
    .trust { text-align: center; margin-top: 30px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--faint); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
    .trust svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--accent); }

    /* ---------- Progress view ---------- */
    .prog-card { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 40px; }
    .prog-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .prog-desc { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
    .bar-outer { height: 10px; background: var(--line); overflow: hidden; }
    .bar-inner { height: 100%; width: 0%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 0.35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }
    .bar-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
    .bar-pct { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
    .pfile-list { margin-top: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; background: var(--line); border: 1px solid var(--line); max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; }
    .pfile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 11px 16px; background: var(--paper); font-size: 13px; }
    .pfile-name { font-family: var(--mono); }
    .pfile-state { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); }
    .pfile-state .ok { color: var(--accent); }
    .pfile-state .reading { color: var(--medium); }

    /* ---------- Results view ---------- */
    .verdict {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px;
        background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        padding: 30px 34px; margin-bottom: 22px;
        border-left: 5px solid var(--accent);
    }
    .verdict.fail { border-left-color: var(--critical); }
    .verdict-badge { width: 62px; height: 62px; flex-shrink: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); }
    .verdict.fail .verdict-badge { background: var(--critical); }
    .verdict-badge svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
    .verdict-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .verdict-desc { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; margin-top: 3px; }

    .metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
    @media (max-width: 720px) { .metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    .metric { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 20px; }
    .metric-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--faint); text-transform: uppercase; }
    .metric-value { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .metric-value.crit { color: var(--critical); }
    .metric-value.ok { color: var(--accent); }

    .section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; margin: 34px 0 16px; }
    .section-head h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .section-head .count { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; color: var(--faint); }

    .finding {
        background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 4px solid var(--medium);
        padding: 16px 20px; margin-bottom: 10px;
        display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: start;
    }
    .finding.critical { border-left-color: var(--critical); }
    .finding.high { border-left-color: var(--high); }
    .finding.medium { border-left-color: var(--medium); }
    .finding.low { border-left-color: var(--low); }
    .sev-tag { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 4px 9px; color: #fff; align-self: center; white-space: nowrap; }
    .sev-tag.critical { background: var(--critical); }
    .sev-tag.high { background: var(--high); }
    .sev-tag.medium { background: var(--medium); }
    .sev-tag.low { background: var(--low); }
    .finding-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
    .finding-file { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); margin-top: 3px; }
    .finding-rec { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 7px; }
    .finding-count { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); align-self: center; }

    .rec { display: flex; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 18px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .rec-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--medium); }
    .rec-dot.critical { background: var(--critical); }
    .rec-dot.high { background: var(--high); }
    .rec-dot.medium { background: var(--medium); }
    .rec-dot.low { background: var(--low); }
    .rec-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
    .rec-body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; }

    .empty { background: var(--accent-soft); border: 1px solid #CBE7DA; color: #0b5e44; padding: 18px 20px; font-size: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .empty svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    .cert { background: var(--ink); color: #F5F5F1; padding: 30px 34px; margin-top: 34px; }
    .cert.fail { background: #2A1A18; }
    .cert-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }
    .cert-logo-chip { background: #fff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; }
    .cert-logo-chip img { height: 44px; width: auto; display: block; }
    .cert-brand-name { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .cert-brand-sub { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #9a9a8e; margin-top: 2px; }
    .cert-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .cert-top svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
    .cert-top .t { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
    .cert-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 18px 32px; }
    .cert-item .k { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #9a9a8e; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .cert-item .v { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 14px; margin-top: 4px; word-break: break-all; }
    .cert-item .v.ok { color: #3ecf8e; }
    .cert-item .v.no { color: #ff6a5c; }

    .actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 30px; }

    .per-file { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; }
    .per-file th, .per-file td { text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .per-file th { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--faint); text-transform: uppercase; background: #FAFAF7; }
    .per-file td { font-family: var(--mono); }
    .per-file tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .pf-ok { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
    .pf-no { color: var(--critical); font-weight: 700; }

    .toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--ink); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); z-index: 40; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="topbar">
        <div class="brand">
            <img class="brand-img" src="auditiq-logo.png" alt="AuditIQ Logo">
            <div>
                <div class="brand-name">AuditIQ</div>
                <div class="brand-sub">DETERMINISTIC CODE AUDIT</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="egress-badge"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="1"/><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"/></svg> ZERO-EGRESS · 100% LOKAL</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ======== VIEW 1: IMPORT ======== -->
    <section id="view-import" class="view active" data-testid="view-import">
        <div class="wrap">
            <div class="import-head">
                <div class="eyebrow">DETERMINISTISCHES CODE-AUDIT</div>
                <h1>Quellcode importieren &amp; prüfen</h1>
                <p class="lead">Dateien auswählen oder hierher ziehen. Die Analyse läuft vollständig lokal in Ihrem Browser — Ihr Code verlässt niemals Ihr Gerät.</p>
            </div>

            <div class="dropzone" id="dropzone" data-testid="dropzone">
                <div class="dz-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 16V4"/><path d="M7 9l5-5 5 5"/><path d="M4 16v3a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h14a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-3"/></svg></div>
                <div class="dz-title">Dateien hierher ziehen</div>
                <div class="dz-hint">oder wählen Sie sie manuell aus</div>
                <button class="btn" id="browseBtn" type="button" data-testid="browse-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 7h5l2 3h11v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>
                    Dateien auswählen
                </button>
                <input type="file" id="fileInput" data-testid="file-input" multiple
                    accept=".js,.mjs,.cjs,.ts,.tsx,.jsx,.html,.htm,.css,.scss,.sass,.json,.yaml,.yml,.toml" style="display:none">
            </div>

            <div class="formats">
                <span class="chip">JavaScript</span><span class="chip">TypeScript</span><span class="chip">JSX / TSX</span>
                <span class="chip">HTML</span><span class="chip">CSS / SCSS</span><span class="chip">JSON</span>
                <span class="chip">YAML</span><span class="chip">TOML</span>
            </div>
            <div class="trust"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3l7 3v6c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 8.5C8 19.5 5 16.5 5 12V6z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg> Keine Uploads, keine Server, keine Cloud — deterministische Analyse.</div>
            <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:20px;">
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="demoBtn" type="button" data-testid="demo-button">Demo mit Beispielcode ansehen</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ======== VIEW 2: PROGRESS ======== -->
    <section id="view-progress" class="view" data-testid="view-progress">
        <div class="wrap">
            <div class="prog-card">
                <div class="prog-title" id="progTitle">Dateien werden eingelesen…</div>
                <div class="prog-desc" id="progDesc">Der Code wird lokal gelesen und für die Analyse vorbereitet.</div>
                <div class="bar-outer"><div class="bar-inner" id="progBar" data-testid="progress-bar"></div></div>
                <div class="bar-meta"><span id="progLabel">Starte…</span><span class="bar-pct" id="progPct">0%</span></div>
                <div class="pfile-list" id="progList"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ======== VIEW 3: RESULTS ======== -->
    <section id="view-results" class="view" data-testid="view-results">
        <div class="wrap wrap-wide">
            <div class="verdict" id="verdict" data-testid="results-verdict">
                <div class="verdict-badge" id="verdictBadge"></div>
                <div>
                    <div class="verdict-title" id="verdictTitle"></div>
                    <div class="verdict-desc" id="verdictDesc"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="metrics" id="metrics"></div>

            <div class="section-head"><h2>Befunde</h2><span class="count" id="findingsCount"></span></div>
            <div id="findingsList" data-testid="findings-list"></div>

            <div class="section-head"><h2>Empfehlungen</h2><span class="count" id="recsCount"></span></div>
            <div id="recsList" data-testid="recommendations-list"></div>

            <div class="section-head"><h2>Datei-Übersicht</h2></div>
            <table class="per-file" data-testid="per-file-table">
                <thead><tr><th>Datei</th><th>Sprache</th><th>Zeilen</th><th>Kritisch</th><th>W(t)</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody id="perFileBody"></tbody>
            </table>

            <div class="cert" id="certCard" data-testid="certificate-card">
                <div class="cert-brand">
                    <span class="cert-logo-chip"><img src="auditiq-logo.png" alt="AuditIQ Logo"></span>
                    <div>
                        <div class="cert-brand-name">AuditIQ</div>
                        <div class="cert-brand-sub">DETERMINISTIC CODE AUDIT · ZERTIFIKAT</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="cert-top" id="certTop"></div>
                <div class="cert-grid" id="certGrid"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="actions">
                <button class="btn" id="newAuditBtn" type="button" data-testid="new-audit-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 1 3 6.7"/><path d="M3 20v-5h5"/></svg>
                    Neues Audit
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="exportBtn" type="button" data-testid="export-report-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><path d="M14 3v5h5"/></svg>
                    Bericht als PDF
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="certBtn" type="button" data-testid="download-cert-button">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3l7 3v6c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 8.5C8 19.5 5 16.5 5 12V6z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg>
                    Zertifikat als PDF
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="site-footer" data-testid="site-footer">
        <div class="cprt">© 2026 <strong>Patrick Frank Buckreus</strong> (geb. 05.01.1996) · AuditIQ · Alle Rechte vorbehalten.</div>
        <div class="meta">Deterministische, zero-egress Code-Analyse — jede Prüfung erzeugt eine zeitgestempelte Signatur.</div>
    </footer>

    <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
    // =========================================================================
    // AuditIQ — AUDIT ENGINE (deterministic, zero-egress)  [field-theory core]
    // =========================================================================
    const PHI = 1.61803398875;
    const OMEGA_CRITICAL = 5800.0;
    const ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 1.0;
    const WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.8;

    function getLanguage(filename) {
        if (filename.endsWith('.js') || filename.endsWith('.mjs') || filename.endsWith('.cjs')) return 'javascript';
        if (filename.endsWith('.ts') || filename.endsWith('.tsx')) return 'typescript';
        if (filename.endsWith('.jsx')) return 'jsx';
        if (filename.endsWith('.html') || filename.endsWith('.htm')) return 'html';
        if (filename.endsWith('.css') || filename.endsWith('.scss') || filename.endsWith('.sass')) return 'css';
        if (filename.endsWith('.json')) return 'json';
        if (filename.endsWith('.yaml') || filename.endsWith('.yml')) return 'yaml';
        if (filename.endsWith('.toml')) return 'toml';
        return 'unknown';
    }

    function analyzeFile(file) {
        const content = file.content;
        const lines = content.split('\n');

        const security = {
            evalCount: (content.match(/\beval\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            innerHTMLCount: (content.match(/\.innerHTML/g) || []).length,
            documentWriteCount: (content.match(/document\.write/g) || []).length,
            sqlConcatCount: (content.match(/SELECT\s+.*\+\s*/gi) || []).length,
            hardcodedSecretCount: (content.match(/password\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"]+['"]/gi) || []).length,
            unsafeDeserializationCount: (content.match(/JSON\.parse\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            xssRiskCount: (content.match(/\.innerHTML|dangerouslySetInnerHTML/g) || []).length,
            insecureRandomCount: (content.match(/Math\.random\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            protoPollutionCount: (content.match(/__proto__|prototype\s*\[/g) || []).length,
            pathTraversalCount: (content.match(/\.\.\/|\.\.\\/g) || []).length,
            postMessageCount: (content.match(/postMessage\s*\([^,]*\)/g) || []).length,
            locationHashCount: (content.match(/location\.hash/g) || []).length,
            dateNowCount: (content.match(/Date\.now\s*\(\s*\)/g) || []).length,
            totalCritical: 0
        };

        security.totalCritical = security.evalCount + security.innerHTMLCount +
                               security.documentWriteCount + security.sqlConcatCount +
                               security.hardcodedSecretCount + security.unsafeDeserializationCount +
                               security.xssRiskCount + security.protoPollutionCount +
                               security.pathTraversalCount + security.postMessageCount;

        const performance = {
            cyclomaticComplexity: (content.match(/\bif\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bwhile\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bfor\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                  (content.match(/\bswitch\s*\(/g) || []).length,
            nestingDepth: Math.max(...content.split('\n').map(line => {
                let depth = 0;
                for (const c of line) {
                    if (c === '{') depth++;
                    if (c === '}') depth--;
                }
                return depth;
            }), 0),
            totalLines: lines.length,
            totalFunctions: (content.match(/function\s+\w*\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                             (content.match(/=>\s*{/g) || []).length,
            nestedLoops: Math.max(0, (content.match(/for\s*\(/g) || []).length +
                                   (content.match(/while\s*\(/g) || []).length - 1),
            blockingIOCount: (content.match(/fs\.readFileSync|fs\.writeFileSync|XMLHttpRequest/g) || []).length
        };

        const cognitive = {
            past: Math.min(performance.cyclomaticComplexity * 0.3, 10.0),
            present: Math.min(performance.nestingDepth * 0.5 + performance.totalFunctions * 0.2, 10.0),
            future: Math.min(security.totalCritical * 0.5, 10.0)
        };

        const loadY = 0.2 * cognitive.past + 0.5 * cognitive.present + 0.3 * cognitive.future;
        const frictionW = Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * PHI;
        const omegaT = frictionW * 14.0;

        return {
            filename: file.filename,
            language: file.language,
            totalLines: lines.length,
            cognitive,
            security,
            performance,
            loadY,
            frictionW,
            omegaT,
            isZeroDefect: loadY <= ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && security.totalCritical === 0,
            isCritical: omegaT >= OMEGA_CRITICAL,
            isWarning: loadY > WARNING_THRESHOLD
        };
    }

    function analyzeFiles(files) {
        const findings = [];
        const fileMetrics = [];

        for (const file of files) {
            const metrics = analyzeFile(file);
            fileMetrics.push(metrics);
        }

        const aggregateCognitive = {
            past: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.past, 0) / fileMetrics.length,
            present: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.present, 0) / fileMetrics.length,
            future: fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.cognitive.future, 0) / fileMetrics.length
        };

        const loadY = 0.2 * aggregateCognitive.past + 0.5 * aggregateCognitive.present + 0.3 * aggregateCognitive.future;
        const frictionW = Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * PHI;
        const omegaT = frictionW * 14.0;

        const totalCritical = fileMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.security.totalCritical, 0);
        const isZeroDefect = loadY <= ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && totalCritical === 0;

        // Deterministic certificate hash (no timestamp -> same code = same hash)
        const certificateHash = generateHash(JSON.stringify({
            files: fileMetrics.map(m => ({ f: m.filename, c: m.security.totalCritical, l: m.loadY })),
            loadY, frictionW, omegaT, totalCritical
        }));

        return {
            aggregateCognitive, loadY, frictionW, omegaT,
            isZeroDefect, totalCritical, findings, fileMetrics,
            certificate: { hash: certificateHash, isValid: isZeroDefect && totalCritical === 0 }
        };
    }

    function generateHash(str) {
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
            const char = str.charCodeAt(i);
            hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;
            hash = hash & hash;
        }
        return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // UI CONTROLLER — Import → Progress → Results
    // =========================================================================
    const SUPPORTED = ['js','mjs','cjs','ts','tsx','jsx','html','htm','css','scss','sass','json','yaml','yml','toml'];
    const LOGO_URI = "data:image/png;base64,";

    // Severity ordering + security pattern catalogue (for clear findings/recs)
    const SEV_ORDER = { critical: 0, high: 1, medium: 2, low: 3 };
    const PATTERNS = [
        { key: 'evalCount',                 label: 'eval()-Aufruf',              sev: 'critical', rec: 'eval() vollständig entfernen — es erlaubt beliebige Codeausführung.' },
        { key: 'sqlConcatCount',            label: 'SQL per String-Konkatenation', sev: 'critical', rec: 'Parametrisierte Queries / Prepared Statements verwenden.' },
        { key: 'hardcodedSecretCount',      label: 'Hardcodiertes Passwort/Secret', sev: 'critical', rec: 'Secrets in Umgebungsvariablen oder einen Secret-Store auslagern.' },
        { key: 'documentWriteCount',        label: 'document.write()',           sev: 'high',     rec: 'Durch sichere DOM-APIs (createElement/append) ersetzen.' },
        { key: 'innerHTMLCount',            label: 'innerHTML-Zuweisung',        sev: 'high',     rec: 'textContent nutzen oder Eingaben strikt sanitizen (XSS-Risiko).' },
        { key: 'protoPollutionCount',       label: 'Prototype-Pollution',        sev: 'high',     rec: '__proto__/prototype-Zugriffe validieren oder Object.create(null) nutzen.' },
        { key: 'pathTraversalCount',        label: 'Path-Traversal (../)',       sev: 'high',     rec: 'Dateipfade normalisieren und gegen eine Whitelist prüfen.' },
        { key: 'insecureRandomCount',       label: 'Math.random() für Zufall',   sev: 'medium',   rec: 'Für sicherheitsrelevanten Zufall crypto.getRandomValues() verwenden.' },
        { key: 'postMessageCount',          label: 'postMessage() ohne Origin-Check', sev: 'medium', rec: 'Bei postMessage stets die Origin des Absenders prüfen.' },
        { key: 'unsafeDeserializationCount',label: 'JSON.parse() auf Eingaben',  sev: 'low',      rec: 'Eingaben vor dem Parsen validieren; try/catch einsetzen.' },
        { key: 'locationHashCount',         label: 'location.hash-Nutzung',      sev: 'low',      rec: 'Hash-Werte als nicht vertrauenswürdige Eingabe behandeln.' }
    ];

    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const svg = p => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${p}</svg>`;
    const ICON_CHECK = svg('<path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/>');
    const ICON_WARN  = svg('<path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/><path d="M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"/>');

    function showView(name) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
        $('view-' + name).classList.add('active');
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' in window ? 'instant' : 'auto' });
    }
    function toast(msg) {
        const t = $('toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
        clearTimeout(toast._t); toast._t = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
    }
    const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
    function readFile(file) {
        return new Promise((res, rej) => {
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = () => res(r.result);
            r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
            r.readAsText(file);
        });
    }

    // ---- Demo (bundled sample code) ----
    const SAMPLE_VULN = [
        "function loadUser(input){",
        "  eval(input);",
        "  document.getElementById('out').innerHTML = input;",
        "  const password = \"supersecret123\";",
        "  document.write('<div>' + input + '</div>');",
        "  let q = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=' + input;",
        "  const d = JSON.parse(input);",
        "  if(input){ if(d){ if(q){ if(password){ if(out){ console.log(1); } } } } }",
        "  for(let i=0;i<9;i++){ for(let j=0;j<9;j++){ for(let k=0;k<9;k++){ console.log(i); } } }",
        "  const r = Math.random();",
        "  obj.__proto__.polluted = true;",
        "  const p = '../../etc/passwd';",
        "  return password;",
        "}"
    ].join("\n");
    const SAMPLE_CLEAN = "export function add(a, b) { return a + b; }\nexport function greet(name) { return 'Hallo ' + name; }";

    async function runDemo() {
        const loaded = [
            { filename: 'beispiel_unsicher.js', content: SAMPLE_VULN, language: 'javascript' },
            { filename: 'beispiel_sauber.js', content: SAMPLE_CLEAN, language: 'javascript' }
        ];
        showView('progress');
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Dateien werden eingelesen…';
        setProgress(0, 'Starte…');
        $('progList').innerHTML = loaded.map((f, i) =>
            `<div class="pfile"><span class="pfile-name">${escapeHtml(f.filename)}</span><span class="pfile-state" id="pfs-${i}">Warten…</span></div>`).join('');
        for (let i = 0; i < loaded.length; i++) {
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="reading">Lese…</span>';
            await sleep(260);
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="ok">✓ Gelesen</span>';
            setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / loaded.length) * 100), `${i + 1} / ${loaded.length} Dateien gelesen`);
        }
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Analyse läuft…';
        setProgress(100, 'Analysiere Muster…');
        await sleep(450);
        const results = analyzeFiles(loaded);
        window.__lastResults = results; window.__lastFiles = loaded;
        renderResults(results);
        showView('results');
    }

    // ---- Import wiring ----
    const dropzone = $('dropzone'), fileInput = $('fileInput');
    $('browseBtn').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); fileInput.click(); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => { if (e.target.files.length) startAudit(e.target.files); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.add('drag'); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropzone.classList.remove('drag'));
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
        e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.remove('drag');
        const items = e.dataTransfer.files;
        if (items && items.length) startAudit(items);
    });

    // ---- Main flow ----
    async function startAudit(fileList) {
        const all = Array.from(fileList);
        const arr = all.filter(f => SUPPORTED.includes((f.name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase()));
        if (arr.length === 0) { toast('Keine unterstützten Dateien gefunden.'); return; }

        showView('progress');
        setProgress(0, 'Starte…');
        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Dateien werden eingelesen…';
        $('progList').innerHTML = arr.map((f, i) =>
            `<div class="pfile"><span class="pfile-name">${escapeHtml(f.name)}</span><span class="pfile-state" id="pfs-${i}">Warten…</span></div>`
        ).join('');

        const loaded = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="reading">Lese…</span>';
            let content = '';
            try { content = await readFile(arr[i]); }
            catch (err) { content = ''; }
            loaded.push({ filename: arr[i].name, content, language: getLanguage(arr[i].name) });
            $('pfs-' + i).innerHTML = '<span class="ok">✓ Gelesen</span>';
            setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / arr.length) * 100), `${i + 1} / ${arr.length} Dateien gelesen`);
            await sleep(140);
        }

        $('progTitle').textContent = 'Analyse läuft…';
        $('progDesc').textContent = 'Feldtheorie-Metriken werden berechnet und Sicherheitsmuster geprüft.';
        setProgress(100, 'Analysiere Muster…');
        await sleep(450);

        const results = analyzeFiles(loaded);
        window.__lastResults = results;
        window.__lastFiles = loaded;
        renderResults(results);
        showView('results');
        $('progDesc').textContent = 'Der Code wird lokal gelesen und für die Analyse vorbereitet.';
    }

    function setProgress(pct, label) {
        $('progBar').style.width = pct + '%';
        $('progPct').textContent = pct + '%';
        $('progLabel').textContent = label;
    }

    // ---- Results rendering ----
    function renderResults(r) {
        const pass = r.isZeroDefect && r.totalCritical === 0;

        // Verdict
        const v = $('verdict');
        v.classList.toggle('fail', !pass);
        $('verdictBadge').innerHTML = pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN;
        $('verdictTitle').textContent = pass ? 'Zero-Defect zertifiziert' : `${r.totalCritical} kritische Befunde`;
        $('verdictDesc').textContent = pass
            ? 'Keine kritischen Sicherheitsmuster erkannt — der Code erfüllt die Zero-Defect-Schwelle.'
            : 'Es wurden sicherheits- oder qualitätsrelevante Muster gefunden. Details siehe unten.';

        // Metrics
        $('metrics').innerHTML = [
            metric('Kritische Befunde', r.totalCritical, r.totalCritical > 0 ? 'crit' : 'ok'),
            metric('Dateien geprüft', r.fileMetrics.length, ''),
            metric('W(t) Last', r.loadY.toFixed(2), r.loadY > WARNING_THRESHOLD ? 'crit' : 'ok'),
            metric('Ω(t) Feld', r.omegaT.toFixed(1), '')
        ].join('');

        // Detailed findings per pattern per file
        const findings = [];
        for (const fm of r.fileMetrics) {
            for (const p of PATTERNS) {
                const c = fm.security[p.key] || 0;
                if (c > 0) findings.push({ sev: p.sev, title: p.label, file: fm.filename, count: c, rec: p.rec });
            }
            if (fm.performance.cyclomaticComplexity > 15)
                findings.push({ sev: 'medium', title: 'Hohe zyklomatische Komplexität', file: fm.filename, count: fm.performance.cyclomaticComplexity, rec: 'Funktionen aufteilen und vereinfachen (Ziel < 15).' });
            if (fm.performance.nestingDepth > 5)
                findings.push({ sev: 'medium', title: 'Tiefe Verschachtelung', file: fm.filename, count: fm.performance.nestingDepth, rec: 'Verschachtelung durch Early Returns reduzieren.' });
        }
        findings.sort((a, b) => SEV_ORDER[a.sev] - SEV_ORDER[b.sev]);

        $('findingsCount').textContent = findings.length ? `${findings.length} gesamt` : '';
        $('findingsList').innerHTML = findings.length ? findings.map(f => `
            <div class="finding ${f.sev}">
                <span class="sev-tag ${f.sev}">${f.sev.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <div>
                    <div class="finding-title">${escapeHtml(f.title)}</div>
                    <div class="finding-file">${escapeHtml(f.file)}</div>
                    <div class="finding-rec">${escapeHtml(f.rec)}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="finding-count">${f.count}×</div>
            </div>`).join('')
            : `<div class="empty">${ICON_CHECK}<span>Keine Befunde — sauber!</span></div>`;

        // Recommendations (aggregated & de-duplicated by pattern)
        const recMap = new Map();
        for (const fm of r.fileMetrics) {
            for (const p of PATTERNS) {
                const c = fm.security[p.key] || 0;
                if (c > 0) recMap.set(p.key, { sev: p.sev, title: p.label + ' beheben', body: p.rec, n: (recMap.get(p.key)?.n || 0) + c });
            }
        }
        const recs = [...recMap.values()].sort((a, b) => SEV_ORDER[a.sev] - SEV_ORDER[b.sev]);
        $('recsCount').textContent = recs.length ? `${recs.length} Maßnahmen` : '';
        $('recsList').innerHTML = recs.length ? recs.map(rc => `
            <div class="rec">
                <span class="rec-dot ${rc.sev}"></span>
                <div>
                    <div class="rec-title">${escapeHtml(rc.title)} <span style="color:var(--faint);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;">(${rc.n}×)</span></div>
                    <div class="rec-body">${escapeHtml(rc.body)}</div>
                </div>
            </div>`).join('')
            : `<div class="empty">${ICON_CHECK}<span>Keine Maßnahmen erforderlich. Weiter so.</span></div>`;

        // Per-file table
        $('perFileBody').innerHTML = r.fileMetrics.map(m => `
            <tr>
                <td>${escapeHtml(m.filename)}</td>
                <td>${m.language}</td>
                <td>${m.totalLines}</td>
                <td>${m.security.totalCritical}</td>
                <td>${m.loadY.toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td class="${m.isZeroDefect ? 'pf-ok' : 'pf-no'}">${m.isZeroDefect ? '✓ Sauber' : '✗ Befunde'}</td>
            </tr>`).join('');

        // Certificate (with timestamped signature + owner)
        const OWNER = 'Patrick Frank Buckreus';
        const now = new Date();
        const stampISO = now.toISOString();
        const stampHuman = now.toLocaleString('de-DE', { dateStyle: 'long', timeStyle: 'medium' });
        const signedHash = generateHash(r.certificate.hash + '|' + stampISO + '|' + OWNER + '|05.01.1996');
        window.__cert = { hash: r.certificate.hash, signedHash, stampISO, stampHuman, owner: OWNER, valid: r.certificate.isValid };

        const cert = $('certCard');
        cert.classList.toggle('fail', !pass);
        $('certTop').innerHTML = (pass ? ICON_CHECK : ICON_WARN) +
            `<span class="t">${pass ? 'AUDITIQ-ZERTIFIKAT' : 'AUDITIQ-ZERTIFIKAT — NICHT BESTANDEN'}</span>`;
        $('certGrid').innerHTML = [
            certItem('Status', pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT ✓' : 'BEFUNDE VORHANDEN ✗', pass ? 'ok' : 'no'),
            certItem('Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)', r.certificate.hash, ''),
            certItem('Zeitstempel', stampHuman, ''),
            certItem('Signatur-Hash (mit Datum & Uhrzeit)', signedHash, pass ? 'ok' : ''),
            certItem('Feldlast W(t)', r.loadY.toFixed(4), ''),
            certItem('Feldstärke Ω(t)', r.omegaT.toFixed(4), ''),
            certItem('Inhaber / Copyright', '© Patrick Frank Buckreus (05.01.1996)', '')
        ].join('');
    }

    function metric(label, value, cls) {
        return `<div class="metric"><div class="metric-label">${label}</div><div class="metric-value ${cls}">${value}</div></div>`;
    }
    function certItem(k, v, cls) {
        return `<div class="cert-item"><div class="k">${k}</div><div class="v ${cls}">${escapeHtml(String(v))}</div></div>`;
    }
    function escapeHtml(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
    }

    // ---- Actions ----
    $('newAuditBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { fileInput.value = ''; showView('import'); });
    $('demoBtn').addEventListener('click', runDemo);
    (function(){
        const dp = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('demo');
        if (dp === 'instant') {
            const loaded = [
                { filename: 'beispiel_unsicher.js', content: SAMPLE_VULN, language: 'javascript' },
                { filename: 'beispiel_sauber.js', content: SAMPLE_CLEAN, language: 'javascript' }
            ];
            const r = analyzeFiles(loaded); window.__lastResults = r; window.__lastFiles = loaded;
            renderResults(r); showView('results');
        } else if (dp) { runDemo(); }
    })();
    $('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', printReport);
    $('certBtn').addEventListener('click', printCertificate);

    function openPrint(title, bodyHtml) {
        const w = window.open('', '_blank');
        if (!w) { toast('Bitte Pop-ups erlauben, um das PDF zu erzeugen.'); return; }
        const css = "*{box-sizing:border-box}body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:#17170F;margin:0;padding:48px;line-height:1.5}"
            + ".doc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;border-bottom:2px solid #17170F;padding-bottom:18px;margin-bottom:28px}"
            + ".doc-head img{height:58px;width:auto}.doc-head .n{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.02em}"
            + ".doc-head .s{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.16em;color:#6B6B60;margin-top:3px}"
            + "h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 14px}.badge{display:inline-block;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;font-size:13px}"
            + ".badge.ok{background:#0E7C5A}.badge.no{background:#C0362C}"
            + "table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin:14px 0}td,th{border:1px solid #E4E3DA;padding:9px 11px;text-align:left}th{background:#FAFAF7;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6B60}"
            + ".kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;gap:8px 20px;font-size:14px;margin:6px 0}.kv .k{color:#6B6B60}.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;word-break:break-all}"
            + ".ok{color:#0E7C5A;font-weight:700}.no{color:#C0362C;font-weight:700}"
            + ".cprt{margin-top:36px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #E4E3DA;font-size:12px;color:#6B6B60}"
            + "@media print{body{padding:24px}}";
        const doc = '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>' + title + '</title><style>' + css + '</style></head><body>'
            + '<div class="doc-head"><img src="' + LOGO_URI + '" alt="AuditIQ"><div><div class="n">AuditIQ</div><div class="s">DETERMINISTIC CODE AUDIT</div></div></div>'
            + bodyHtml
            + '<div class="cprt">© 2026 Patrick Frank Buckreus (geb. 05.01.1996) · AuditIQ · Alle Rechte vorbehalten.</div>'
            + '<scr' + 'ipt>window.onload=function(){setTimeout(function(){window.focus();window.print();},350);}</scr' + 'ipt>'
            + '</body></html>';
        w.document.open(); w.document.write(doc); w.document.close();
        toast('PDF-Ansicht geöffnet — im Druckdialog „Als PDF speichern“ wählen.');
    }

    function printReport() {
        const r = window.__lastResults, c = window.__cert || {}; if (!r) return;
        const pass = r.isZeroDefect && r.totalCritical === 0;
        const rows = r.fileMetrics.map(m =>
            '<tr><td class="mono">' + escapeHtml(m.filename) + '</td><td>' + m.language + '</td><td>' + m.totalLines + '</td><td>' + m.security.totalCritical + '</td><td>' + m.loadY.toFixed(2) + '</td><td class="' + (m.isZeroDefect ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (m.isZeroDefect ? 'Sauber' : 'Befunde') + '</td></tr>').join('');
        const body = '<h1>Code-Audit Bericht</h1>'
            + '<span class="badge ' + (pass ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT ZERTIFIZIERT' : r.totalCritical + ' KRITISCHE BEFUNDE') + '</span>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:20px"><span class="k">Zeitstempel</span><span>' + escapeHtml(c.stampHuman || '') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Dateien</span><span>' + r.fileMetrics.length + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldlast W(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.loadY.toFixed(4) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldstärke Ω(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.omegaT.toFixed(4) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)</span><span class="mono">' + r.certificate.hash + '</span>'

            + '<h1 style="margin-top:28px">Datei-Übersicht</h1>'
            + '<table><thead><tr><th>Datei</th><th>Sprache</th><th>Zeilen</th><th>Kritisch</th><th>W(t)</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>';
        openPrint('AuditIQ Bericht', body);

    function printCertificate() {
        const r = window.__lastResults, c = window.__cert || {}; if (!r) return;
        const pass = r.certificate.isValid;
        const body = '<h1>Seinsmodus-Zertifikat</h1>'
            + '<span class="badge ' + (pass ? 'ok' : 'no') + '">' + (pass ? 'ZERO-DEFECT · GÜLTIG' : 'NICHT BESTANDEN') + '</span>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:22px">'

            + '<span class="k">Inhalts-Signatur (SHA)</span><span class="mono">' + r.certificate.hash + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Signatur-Hash (Datum & Uhrzeit)</span><span class="mono">' + (c.signedHash || '') + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldlast W(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.loadY.toFixed(6) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Feldstärke Ω(t)</span><span class="mono">' + r.omegaT.toFixed(6) + '</span>'
            + '<span class="k">Dateien</span><span>' + r.fileMetrics.length + '</span>'

        openPrint('AuditIQ Zertifikat', body);
    }

    console.log('AuditIQ bereit — zero-egress, client-side engine active. © Patrick Frank Buckreus');
</script>

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project("audit_engine")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -O3 -Wall -Wextra")

# WASM build configuration
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='AuditEngineModule' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1")
    set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=['ccall','cwrap']")
    
    add_library(audit_engine STATIC
        audit_engine.cpp
    )
    
    # Export C functions for WASM
    target_compile_definitions(audit_engine PRIVATE
        __EMSCRIPTEN__
    )
    
    # Explicitly export WASM functions
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/emscripten_export.config")
        include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/emscripten_export.config)
    endif()
else()
    add_library(audit_engine STATIC
        audit_engine.cpp
    )
endif()

# Include directory
target_include_directories(audit_engine PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

// dependency_graph.js - Dependency graph analysis with Tarjan's cycle detection
// Implements deterministic dependency analysis for the Code Auditor

class DependencyGraph {
    constructor() {
        this.PHI = 1.61803398875;
        this.OMEGA_CRITICAL = 5800.0;
        this.ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 1.0;
        this.WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.8;
    }

    // Build dependency graph from file list
    buildGraph(files) {
        const graph = new Map();
        const reverseGraph = new Map();
        const fileNames = [];

        // Initialize nodes
        for (const file of files) {
            const name = file.filename;
            fileNames.push(name);
            graph.set(name, []);
            reverseGraph.set(name, []);
        }

        // Extract dependencies from each file
        for (const file of files) {
            const deps = this._extractDependencies(file.content, file.filename);
            for (const dep of deps) {
                if (graph.has(dep)) {
                    graph.get(file.filename).push(dep);
                    reverseGraph.get(dep).push(file.filename);
                }
            }
        }

        return { graph, reverseGraph, fileNames };
    }

    // Extract dependencies from file content
    _extractDependencies(content, filename) {
        const deps = new Set();

        // JavaScript/TypeScript imports
        const importPatterns = [
            /import\s+.*\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g,
            /import\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g,
            /require\s*\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g,
            /const\s+\w+\s*=\s*require\s*\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g,
            /import\s+\*\s+as\s+\w+\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g
        ];

        for (const pattern of importPatterns) {
            const matches = content.matchAll(pattern);
            for (const match of matches) {
                const dep = match[1];
                // Resolve relative imports
                if (dep.startsWith('.')) {
                    const resolved = this._resolvePath(filename, dep);
                    if (resolved) deps.add(resolved);
                } else {
                    deps.add(dep);
                }
            }
        }

        // CSS @import
        const cssImportMatches = content.match(/@import\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g);
        if (cssImportMatches) {
            for (const match of cssImportMatches) {
                const dep = match.match(/['"]([^'"]+)['"]/)[1];
                deps.add(dep);
            }
        }

        // HTML <link> and <script> tags
        const linkMatches = content.match(/<link[^>]+href\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/gi);
        if (linkMatches) {
            for (const match of linkMatches) {
                const dep = match.match(/href\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/i)[1];
                deps.add(dep);
            }
        }

        const scriptMatches = content.match(/<script[^>]+src\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/gi);
        if (scriptMatches) {
            for (const match of scriptMatches) {
                const dep = match.match(/src\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/i)[1];
                deps.add(dep);
            }
        }

        return Array.from(deps);
    }

    // Resolve relative path
    _resolvePath(fromFile, importPath) {
        const fromDir = fromFile.substring(0, fromFile.lastIndexOf('/'));
        const parts = fromPath.split('/');
        const resolvedParts = fromDir.split('/');
        
        for (const part of parts) {
            if (part === '.') continue;
            if (part === '..') resolvedParts.pop();
            else resolvedParts.push(part);
        }
        
        return resolvedParts.join('/');
    }

    // Tarjan's algorithm for strongly connected components (cycle detection)
    findCycles(graph, fileNames) {
        const indexCounter = { value: 0 };
        const stack = [];
        const lowlinks = new Map();
        const index = new Map();
        const onStack = new Map();
        const sccs = [];

        const strongConnect = (node) => {
            index.set(node, indexCounter.value);
            lowlinks.set(node, indexCounter.value);
            indexCounter.value++;
            stack.push(node);
            onStack.set(node, true);

            const neighbors = graph.get(node) || [];
            for (const neighbor of neighbors) {
                if (!index.has(neighbor)) {
                    strongConnect(neighbor);
                    lowlinks.set(node, Math.min(lowlinks.get(node), lowlinks.get(neighbor)));
                } else if (onStack.get(neighbor)) {
                    lowlinks.set(node, Math.min(lowlinks.get(node), index.get(neighbor)));
                }
            }

            if (lowlinks.get(node) === index.get(node)) {
                const scc = [];
                let w;
                do {
                    w = stack.pop();
                    onStack.set(w, false);
                    scc.push(w);
                } while (w !== node);
                if (scc.length > 1) {
                    sccs.push(scc);
                }
            }
        };

        for (const node of fileNames) {
            if (!index.has(node)) {
                strongConnect(node);
            }
        }

        return sccs;
    }

    // Compute coupling metrics
    computeCoupling(graph, reverseGraph, fileNames) {
        const afferent = new Map(); // Ca: incoming dependencies
        const efferent = new Map(); // Ce: outgoing dependencies

        for (const file of fileNames) {
            afferent.set(file, (reverseGraph.get(file) || []).length);
            efferent.set(file, (graph.get(file) || []).length);
        }

        return { afferent, efferent };
    }

    // Compute cohesion metrics (simplified)
    computeCohesion(files) {
        const cohesion = new Map();
        
        for (const file of files) {
            const content = file.content;
            const lines = content.split('\n');
            
            // Count related functions/classes in same file
            const functions = (content.match(/\bfunction\s+\w+/g) || []).length;
            const classes = (content.match(/\bclass\s+\w+/g) || []).length;
            const relatedEntities = functions + classes;
            
            // Cohesion = related entities / total lines (normalized)
            const score = relatedEntities > 0 ? 
                Math.min(relatedEntities / Math.max(lines.length, 1) * 10, 1.0) : 0;
            
            cohesion.set(file.filename, score);
        }
        
        return cohesion;
    }

    // Analyze full dependency structure
    analyze(files) {
        const { graph, reverseGraph, fileNames } = this.buildGraph(files);
        const cycles = this.findCycles(graph, fileNames);
        const { afferent, efferent } = this.computeCoupling(graph, reverseGraph, fileNames);
        const cohesion = this.computeCohesion(files);

        // Compute instability: I = Ce / (Ca + Ce)
        const instability = new Map();
        for (const file of fileNames) {
            const ca = afferent.get(file) || 0;
            const ce = efferent.get(file) || 0;
            instability.set(file, ca + ce > 0 ? ce / (ca + ce) : 0);
        }

        // Compute abstractness: A = (classes + interfaces) / (total classes + interfaces + dependencies)
        const abstractness = new Map();
        for (const file of files) {
            const classes = (file.content.match(/\bclass\s+\w+/g) || []).length;
            const interfaces = (file.content.match(/\binterface\s+\w+/g) || []).length;
            const deps = (graph.get(file.filename) || []).length;
            abstractness.set(file.filename, classes + interfaces + deps > 0 ? 
                (classes + interfaces) / (classes + interfaces + deps) : 0);
        }

        // Compute cognitive impact of dependency structure
        const cognitive = {
            past: cycles.length * 0.5, // Circular dependencies create past debt
            present: fileNames.length * 0.1, // Number of files affects current processing
            future: cycles.length * 0.8 // Circular dependencies create future risk
        };

        return {
            graph,
            reverseGraph,
            fileNames,
            cycles,
            afferent,
            efferent,
            cohesion,
            instability,
            abstractness,
            cognitive
        };
    }

    // Compute loadY from dependency analysis
    computeLoadY(cv) {
        return 0.2 * cv.past + 0.5 * cv.present + 0.3 * cv.future;
    }

    // Compute frictionW
    computeFrictionW(loadY) {
        return Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * this.PHI;
    }

    // Compute Ω(t)
    computeOmegaT(frictionW) {
        return frictionW * 14.0;
    }

    // Check Zero-Defect
    checkZeroDefect(loadY, criticalCount) {
        return loadY <= this.ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && criticalCount === 0;
    }

    // Check critical
    checkCritical(omegaT) {
        return omegaT >= this.OMEGA_CRITICAL;
    }

    // Check warning
    checkWarning(loadY) {
        return loadY > this.WARNING_THRESHOLD;
    }
}

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = DependencyGraph;
}

// monetization_analyzer.js - Monetarisierungsmodell-Bewertung & Anpassungsvorschläge
// Implements deterministic monetization model analysis for the Code Auditor

class MonetizationAnalyzer {
    constructor() {
        this.PHI = 1.61803398875;
        this.OMEGA_CRITICAL = 5800.0;
        this.ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 1.0;
        this.WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.8;

        // Platform fee structures
        this.PLATFORM_FEES = {
            apple: {
                inAppPurchase: 0.30, // 30% for first year, 15% after
                subscription: 0.30,
                physicalGoods: 0.00, // No fee for physical goods
                b2b: 0.00 // No fee for B2B
            },
            google: {
                inAppPurchase: 0.30, // 30% for first year, 15% after
                subscription: 0.30,
                physicalGoods: 0.00,
                b2b: 0.00
            },
            web: {
                stripe: 0.029 + 0.30, // 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction
                paypal: 0.029 + 0.30,
                direct: 0.00
            }
        };

        // Revenue models
        this.REVENUE_MODELS = {
            subscription: 'Subscription',
            oneTime: 'One-time purchase',
            payPerUse: 'Pay-per-use',
            inAppPurchase: 'In-app purchase',
            freemium: 'Freemium',
            advertising: 'Advertising',
            marketplace: 'Marketplace commission'
        };
    }

    // Analyze monetization model
    analyzeMonetization(files) {
        const findings = [];
        const metrics = {
            revenueModel: 'unknown',
            platformFees: {},
            optimizationOpportunities: [],
            paymentIntegration: 'none',
            totalViolations: 0
        };

        // Detect revenue model from code
        for (const file of files) {
            const content = file.content;
            const filename = file.filename;

            // Subscription model
            if (content.includes('subscription') || content.includes('recurring')) {
                metrics.revenueModel = 'subscription';
            }

            // One-time purchase
            if (content.includes('one-time') || content.includes('single purchase')) {
                metrics.revenueModel = 'oneTime';
            }

            // Pay-per-use
            if (content.includes('pay-per-use') || content.includes('pay per use') || 
                content.includes('credit') || content.includes('token')) {
                metrics.revenueModel = 'payPerUse';
            }

            // In-app purchase
            if (content.includes('in_app_purchase') || content.includes('InAppPurchase') ||
                content.includes('IAP') || content.includes('in-app purchase')) {
                metrics.revenueModel = 'inAppPurchase';
            }

            // Freemium
            if (content.includes('freemium') || content.includes('free tier') ||
                content.includes('premium') || content.includes('pro')) {
                if (metrics.revenueModel === 'unknown') {
                    metrics.revenueModel = 'freemium';
                }
            }

            // Detect payment integration
            if (content.includes('stripe') || content.includes('Stripe')) {
                metrics.paymentIntegration = 'stripe';
            } else if (content.includes('paypal') || content.includes('PayPal')) {
                metrics.paymentIntegration = 'paypal';
            } else if (content.includes('in_app_purchase') || content.includes('InAppPurchase')) {
                metrics.paymentIntegration = 'native';
            }

            // Check for platform-specific compliance
            if (filename.includes('AndroidManifest.xml') || filename.includes('build.gradle')) {
                if (content.includes('com.android.vending') || content.includes('com.google.android.play')) {
                    // Google Play billing detected
                    const hasGoogleBilling = content.includes('BillingClient') || 
                                           content.includes('com.android.billingclient');
                    
                    if (metrics.revenueModel === 'inAppPurchase' && !hasGoogleBilling) {
                        metrics.totalViolations++;
                        findings.push({
                            type: 'play_missing_billing',
                            severity: 'critical',
                            message: 'Digital goods sold without Google Play Billing integration',
                            file: filename,
                            penalty: 50.0,
                            recommendation: 'Integrate Google Play Billing Library for in-app purchases'
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            if (filename.includes('Info.plist')) {
                if (content.includes('SKPayment') || content.includes('StoreKit')) {
                    // Apple IAP detected
                    if (metrics.revenueModel === 'inAppPurchase') {
                        // Check if Sign in with Apple is also present
                        if (!content.includes('ASAuthorization')) {
                            metrics.totalViolations++;
                            findings.push({
                                type: 'apple_missing_signin',
                                severity: 'critical',
                                message: 'In-app purchases detected without Sign in with Apple',
                                file: filename,
                                penalty: 45.0,
                                recommendation: 'Add Sign in with Apple (Guideline 4.8)'
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Analyze platform fees and optimization opportunities
        this._analyzePlatformFees(metrics, findings);

        // Check for hybrid payment model opportunities
        this._analyzeHybridPayment(metrics, findings);

        // Check for paywall and funnel optimization
        this._analyzePaywallFunnel(files, metrics, findings);

        return { metrics, findings };
    }

    _analyzePlatformFees(metrics, findings) {
        if (metrics.revenueModel === 'inAppPurchase') {
            metrics.platformFees = {
                apple: this.PLATFORM_FEES.apple.inAppPurchase,
                google: this.PLATFORM_FEES.google.inAppPurchase
            };

            // Check for optimization opportunities
            if (metrics.paymentIntegration === 'native') {
                metrics.optimizationOpportunities.push({
                    type: 'hybrid_payment',
                    description: 'Consider hybrid payment model: native IAP for digital goods, web billing for physical/B2B',
                    potentialSavings: '30% platform fee reduction for eligible transactions'
                });
            }
        } else if (metrics.revenueModel === 'subscription') {
            metrics.platformFees = {
                apple: this.PLATFORM_FEES.apple.subscription,
                google: this.PLATFORM_FEES.google.subscription
            };
        } else if (metrics.revenueModel === 'oneTime') {
            metrics.platformFees = {
                apple: this.PLATFORM_FEES.apple.inAppPurchase,
                google: this.PLATFORM_FEES.google.inAppPurchase
            };
        }
    }

    _analyzeHybridPayment(metrics, findings) {
        // Identify opportunities for web-based billing to avoid platform fees
        if (metrics.revenueModel === 'inAppPurchase' || metrics.revenueModel === 'subscription') {
            findings.push({
                type: 'hybrid_payment_opportunity',
                severity: 'medium',
                message: 'Consider hybrid payment model to reduce platform fees',
                file: 'project root',
                penalty: 0,
                recommendation: 'For physical goods or B2B services, use web-based billing (Stripe/PayPal) instead of platform IAP to avoid 30% fees'
            });

            metrics.optimizationOpportunities.push({
                type: 'fee_optimization',
                description: 'Switch from platform IAP to web billing for eligible goods',
                potentialSavings: 'Up to 30% fee reduction per transaction'
            });
        }
    }

    _analyzePaywallFunnel(files, metrics, findings) {
        let hasAuth = false;
        let hasCheckout = false;
        let hasOnboarding = false;
        let hasConfirmation = false;

        for (const file of files) {
            const content = file.content;
            
            if (content.includes('signup') || content.includes('register') || 
                content.includes('login') || content.includes('auth')) {
                hasAuth = true;
            }
            
            if (content.includes('checkout') || content.includes('payment') ||
                content.includes('buy') || content.includes('purchase')) {
                hasCheckout = true;
            }
            
            if (content.includes('onboarding') || content.includes('tutorial') ||
                content.includes('walkthrough')) {
                hasOnboarding = true;
            }
            
            if (content.includes('confirm') || content.includes('success') ||
                content.includes('thank')) {
                hasConfirmation = true;
            }
        }

        // Check for friction points
        if (hasAuth && hasCheckout) {
            // Check for too many steps
            const steps = [hasAuth, hasOnboarding, hasCheckout, hasConfirmation].filter(Boolean).length;
            if (steps > 3) {
                findings.push({
                    type: 'funnel_friction',
                    severity: 'medium',
                    message: `Checkout funnel has ${steps} steps - potential for high abandonment`,
                    file: 'project root',
                    penalty: 15.0,
                    recommendation: 'Reduce funnel steps to 3 or fewer (auth -> payment -> confirmation)'
                });
            }
        }

        // Check for cognitive barriers
        for (const file of files) {
            const content = file.content;
            if (content.includes('password') && content.includes('confirm password')) {
                findings.push({
                    type: 'cognitive_barrier',
                    severity: 'low',
                    message: 'Password confirmation field increases cognitive load',
                    file: file.filename,
                    penalty: 5.0,
                    recommendation: 'Consider passwordless authentication or single password field with visibility toggle'
                });
            }
        }
    }

    computeLoadY(cv) {
        return 0.2 * cv.past + 0.5 * cv.present + 0.3 * cv.future;
    }

    computeFrictionW(loadY) {
        return Math.abs(loadY - 0.5) * this.PHI;
    }

    computeOmegaT(frictionW) {
        return frictionW * 14.0;
    }

    checkZeroDefect(loadY, criticalCount) {
        return loadY <= this.ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD && criticalCount === 0;
    }

    checkCritical(omegaT) {
        return omegaT >= this.OMEGA_CRITICAL;
    }

    checkWarning(loadY) {
        return loadY > this.WARNING_THRESHOLD;
    }
}

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = MonetizationAnalyzer;
}

// runtime_analyzer.js - Dynamic/runtime analysis capabilities
// Implements deterministic runtime behavior analysis for the Code Auditor
// Zero-egress: all analysis happens locally in browser

class RuntimeAnalyzer {
    constructor() {
        this.PHI = 1.61803398875;
        this.OMEGA_CRITICAL = 5800.0;
        this.ZERO_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 1.0;
        this.WARNING_THRESHOLD = 0.8;
        
        // Runtime behavior patterns
        this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS = {
            memoryLeak: [
                { pattern: /setInterval\s*\(/g, message: 'setInterval without clearInterval - potential memory leak' },
                { pattern: /setTimeout\s*\(/g, message: 'setTimeout without clearTimeout - potential memory leak' },
                { pattern: /addEventListener\s*\(/g, message: 'addEventListener without removeEventListener - potential memory leak' },
                { pattern: /new\s+EventSource/g, message: 'EventSource without close() - potential memory leak' },
                { pattern: /WebSocket\(/g, message: 'WebSocket without close() - potential memory leak' }
            ],
            asyncIssues: [
                { pattern: /Promise\.all\s*\(/g, message: 'Promise.all - potential unhandled rejection' },
                { pattern: /\.then\s*\(\s*\)/g, message: 'Promise chain without catch - unhandled rejection risk' },
                { pattern: /async\s+function/g, message: 'Async function - ensure proper error handling' }
            ],
            raceConditions: [
                { pattern: /Promise\.race\s*\(/g, message: 'Promise.race - potential race condition' },
                { pattern: /await\s+.*\n.*await/g, message: 'Multiple awaits in sequence - potential race condition' }
            ],
            resourceExhaustion: [
                { pattern: /while\s*\(\s*true\s*\)/g, message: 'Infinite loop - potential resource exhaustion' },
                { pattern: /Array\.from\s*\(\s*\{.*length:\s*Infinity/g, message: 'Infinite array creation - potential resource exhaustion' }
            ],
            timingAttacks: [
                { pattern: /===.*password|password.*===/gi, message: 'Direct string comparison of passwords - timing attack risk' },
                { pattern: /==.*token|token.*==/gi, message: 'Direct string comparison of tokens - timing attack risk' }
            ]
        };
    }

    // Analyze runtime behavior patterns
    analyzeRuntime(content, language = 'javascript') {
        const findings = [];
        const metrics = {
            memoryLeakRisk: 0,
            asyncIssues: 0,
            raceConditions: 0,
            resourceExhaustion: 0,
            timingAttackRisk: 0,
            totalRuntimeIssues: 0
        };

        // Memory leak detection
        for (const { pattern, message } of this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS.memoryLeak) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                metrics.memoryLeakRisk += matches.length;
                findings.push({
                    type: 'memoryLeak',
                    severity: 'medium',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: 20.0 * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Ensure proper cleanup of intervals, timeouts, and event listeners'
                });
            }
        }

        // Async issues detection
        for (const { pattern, message } of this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS.asyncIssues) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                metrics.asyncIssues += matches.length;
                findings.push({
                    type: 'asyncIssue',
                    severity: 'low',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: 10.0 * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Add proper error handling with .catch() or try/catch'
                });
            }
        }

        // Race condition detection
        for (const { pattern, message } of this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS.raceConditions) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                metrics.raceConditions += matches.length;
                findings.push({
                    type: 'raceCondition',
                    severity: 'high',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: 30.0 * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Use proper synchronization or state management'
                });
            }
        }

        // Resource exhaustion detection
        for (const { pattern, message } of this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS.resourceExhaustion) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                metrics.resourceExhaustion += matches.length;
                findings.push({
                    type: 'resourceExhaustion',
                    severity: 'critical',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: 50.0 * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Add proper termination conditions and resource limits'
                });
            }
        }

        // Timing attack detection
        for (const { pattern, message } of this.RUNTIME_PATTERNS.timingAttacks) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                metrics.timingAttackRisk += matches.length;
                findings.push({
                    type: 'timingAttack',
                    severity: 'high',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: 40.0 * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Use crypto.timingSafeEqual for security-sensitive comparisons'
                });
            }
        }

        metrics.totalRuntimeIssues = metrics.memoryLeakRisk + metrics.asyncIssues + 
                                     metrics.raceConditions + metrics.resourceExhaustion + 
                                     metrics.timingAttackRisk;

        return { metrics, findings };
    }

    // Analyze event loop blocking
    analyzeEventLoopBlocking(content) {
        const findings = [];
        const blockingPatterns = [
            { pattern: /while\s*\(\s*true\s*\)/g, message: 'Infinite loop blocks event loop', penalty: 50.0 },
            { pattern: /for\s*\(\s*let\s+i\s*=\s*0\s*;\s*i\s*<.*;\s*i\+\+\s*\)/g, message: 'Heavy synchronous loop blocks event loop', penalty: 30.0 },
            { pattern: /Array\.from\s*\(\s*\{.*length:\s*\d{6,}/g, message: 'Large array creation blocks event loop', penalty: 25.0 },
            { pattern: /JSON\.parse\s*\(\s*["'].{10000,}["']\s*\)/g, message: 'Large JSON parse blocks event loop', penalty: 35.0 }
        ];

        for (const { pattern, message, penalty } of blockingPatterns) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                findings.push({
                    type: 'eventLoopBlocking',
                    severity: 'high',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: penalty * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Use setImmediate, process.nextTick, or break work into chunks'
                });
            }
        }

        return findings;
    }

    // Analyze garbage collection pressure
    analyzeGCPressure(content) {
        const findings = [];
        const gcPatterns = [
            { pattern: /new\s+Array\s*\(\s*\d{6,}/g, message: 'Large array allocation causes GC pressure', penalty: 20.0 },
            { pattern: /new\s+String\s*\(/g, message: 'String object creation causes GC pressure', penalty: 10.0 },
            { pattern: /new\s+Number\s*\(/g, message: 'Number object creation causes GC pressure', penalty: 10.0 },
            { pattern: /\[\]\.concat\s*\(/g, message: 'Array concatenation creates new arrays - GC pressure', penalty: 15.0 }
        ];

        for (const { pattern, message, penalty } of gcPatterns) {
            const matches = content.match(pattern) || [];
            if (matches.length > 0) {
                findings.push({
                    type: 'gcPressure',
                    severity: 'low',
                    message: `${message} (${matches.length} occurrences)`,
                    file: '',
                    line: 0,
                    penalty: penalty * matches.length,
                    recommendation: 'Reuse objects and arrays where possible'
                });
            }
        }

        return findings;
    }

    // Full runtime analysis
    analyze(content, language = 'javascript') {
        const runtimeFindings = this.analyzeRuntime(content, language);
        const eventLoopFindings = this.analyzeEventLoopBlocking(content);
        const gcFindings = this.analyzeGCPressure(content);
        
        const allFindings = [...runtimeFindings.findings, ...eventLoopFindings, ...gcFindings];
        const allMetrics = {
            ...runtimeFindings.metrics,
            eventLoopBlocking: eventLoopFindings.length,
            gcPressure: gcFindings.length,
            totalRuntimeIssues: allFindings.length
        };

        return {
            metrics: allMetrics,
            findings: allFindings
        };
    }
}

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = RuntimeAnalyzer;
}
